item.title: Sharks may have Macklin Celebrini back for division game vs. Oilers
item.description: The San Jose Sharks hope to have captain Macklin Celebrini back in the lineup when they host Connor McDavid and the Edmonton Oilers in the first 2026-27 meeting between the division rivals on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The San Jose Sharks hope to have captain Macklin Celebrini back in the lineup when they host Connor McDavid and the Edmonton Oilers in the first 2026-27 meeting between the division rivals on Saturday afternoon. Celebrini, 20, missed the Sharks' recent two-game road trip with a lower-body injury. He is considered day-to-day. The Sharks split an early-season trip against Central Division competition. They were shut out 5-0 by the Dallas Stars and then defeated the St. Louis Blues 3-2 in overtime. Against St. Louis, San Jose climbed out of a 1-0 hole when Tyler Toffoli tied the game at 11:12 of the second period. Dillon Dube helped the Blues regain a one-goal lead in the third frame, but Collin Graf tied it again to send the game to overtime. In OT, Sharks rookie forward Ivar Stenberg, selected second overall in the 2026 NHL Draft, set up Darnell Nurse for the game-winning goal. The veteran defenseman beat St. Louis goaltender Joel Hofer at 1:03 of the extra session to complete the comeback. "It felt amazing," said Nurse, who was traded from Edmonton to San Jose in July. "It was nice to battle back. It took us a little bit in the first. Our team was resilient and then got to our game. (In) the third period, we started establishing ourselves. It's fun to win and fun to add into that." Nurse said that Stenberg has a great awareness of what's happening on the ice. "He sees the whole game," Nurse said. "I was able to make a nice move there and pull up and just got the puck on the middle of my stick and just shot to the middle of the net." The Oilers opened their season with a 6-5 overtime loss to the Vancouver Canucks but have since won three straight. In their last game, against the Ducks on Wednesday in Anaheim, the Oilers exited the first period trailing 2-0 but then scored five goals on 11 shots in the second frame. Evan Bouchard scored twice and added an assist, McDavid had a goal and two assists, and Leon Draisaitl had four assists as Edmonton won 5-2. "After the first (period), we're like, 'You know what? What could possibly go more wrong, so just go out there and start working,' and we did," Oilers defenseman Mattias Ekholm said. "We got a good start, right off the bat, with a big goal, first shift, and just kept on plugging away from there." --Field Level Media

item.title: Erik Prince's forces suffer battlefield loss in Congo, former UFC fighter among wounded, sources say
item.description: Blackwater founder Erik Prince's forces suffered a major battlefield loss in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-September when enemy forces ambushed them, killing and wounding at least 20 people, including a popular former UFC fighter, sources close to the government and his company said.
item.dc:creator: Jessica Donati
item.content:encoded: Blackwater founder Erik Prince's forces suffered a major battlefield loss in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-September when enemy forces ambushed them, killing and wounding at least 20 people, including a popular former UFC fighter, sources close to the government and his company said. The frontline clash shows how Prince, an ally and supporter of US President Donald Trump, has taken on an expanded role in Congo through his company Vectus Global. The company, which also operates in Haiti and other parts of Africa, provides consulting and security services and previously [USN:L6N3XA0X0 TEXT:"helped Congo’s army"] secure the city of Uvira in South Kivu against Rwanda-backed rebels who control swathes of the east. A veteran special operator reported on his podcast earlier this week that former US Green Beret and Ultimate Fighting Championship contestant Tim Kennedy was injured in Congo. The involvement of Prince's forces and the number of casualties have not previously been reported. The attack in South Kivu on September 17 left about 20 dead and wounded, two sources working with Congo's government said. The dead included at least seven Congolese and a former member of New Zealand's Special Forces, while the wounded included Kennedy and another foreign contractor, the sources said. A Vectus Global representative declined to comment. The company has not previously suffered casualties in Congo, a source with direct knowledge of the operation said. One of the sources who works for Congo's government said that Rwandan forces backing the M23 rebels may have surprised them by tracking a drone used for surveillance operations to their location. Spokespeople for the Congolese and Rwandan governments and for the M23 did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Kennedy, the former mixed martial arts fighter, survived the attack with three gunshot wounds to the leg, three sources said, and is being treated at the Walter Reed National Military Medical Center in the suburbs of Washington. Kennedy has a popular podcast channel and millions of followers on social media. Trump is a fan of UFC, [USN:L6N42N00Z TEXT:"hosting fights"] at the White House this year. The US State Department and Walter Reed declined to comment. Kennedy's parents did not respond to requests for comment. A Congolese security source, who said some 20 people were wounded and killed in the attack, added that villagers were likely among the casualties as well. Reuters spoke to at least 10 sources either with direct knowledge of the attack or briefed on the outcome. PRINCE TOOK EXPANDED ROLE IN CONGO'S CONFLICT Prince's initial mandate in Congo was to secure and improve revenue collection from the country's vast mineral reserves, which have been plundered for decades, fuelling relentless conflict in the east. But in January and early February, his forces deployed to Uvira after Washington helped broker a deal for Rwandan-backed rebels to withdraw from the strategic town. The size of Prince's forces in Congo is unclear. One of the sources with direct knowledge of the attack said the Vectus team was travelling between locations when the ambush took place and its sophistication suggested Rwandan forces were involved. "It reinforces the need for DRC sovereignty to be restored. It's an incredibly dangerous place right now," the source said. Two other sources said the ambush was carried out by the Rwandan military. Prince is the founder of now-defunct private military firm Blackwater, some of whose members were pardoned in 2020 for killing Iraqi civilians. The State Department has said it does not have any contracts with Prince in Congo, though US officials have said they plan to work [USN:L1N43O0RW TEXT:"more closely with Vectus Global"] in Haiti. The deal for Rwandan-backed rebels to withdraw from Uvira was part of [USN:L6N3XA0X0 TEXT:"wider agreements"] brokered by the Trump administration to try to end the conflict in eastern Congo. POPULAR PODCASTER Kennedy, a father of four, has posted his views on politics, culture, fitness and more on social media. He also runs a popular YouTube podcast in which he interviews UFC fighters, veterans, cultural disruptors and others. He has often posted about his family, including four young children. In late August, he posted about having "incredible conversations about what being a man means and what sacrifice really looks like" with his son. He did not disclose details about his upcoming trip to Congo. The United Nations and Western powers say Rwanda backs M23, even exercising command and control over the group. Rwanda denies this. Fighting in the decades-long conflict flared early last year, with M23 fighters making rapid gains in the east, which is rich in tantalum, gold, lithium and other minerals.

item.title: Preços do açúcar bruto sobem, enquanto café arábica atinge menor cotação em uma semana
item.description: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram nesta sexta-feira, voltando a se aproximar da máxima de 19 meses registrada no início desta semana, enquanto os preços do café arábica apresentaram ligeira queda.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto na bolsa ICE subiram nesta sexta-feira, voltando a se aproximar da máxima de 19 meses registrada no início desta semana, enquanto os preços do café arábica apresentaram ligeira queda. AÇÚCAR * O contrato de açúcar bruto subiu 0,5%, para 20,25 centavos por libra-peso. O contrato havia atingido uma máxima de 19 meses, de 21,24 centavos, na quarta-feira. No acumulado da semana, registrou alta de 1,6%. * Os corretores afirmaram que o fenômeno climático El Niño ajudou a impulsionar os preços para cima. * "Não há dúvida de que esse fenômeno climático, com intensidade excepcional nesta temporada, está afetando fortemente a produtividade em todo o mundo: cana alagada no Brasil, beterraba atingida pela seca na Europa, plantio paralisado no oeste da Índia", afirmou a Deepcore, corretora de açúcar físico, em nota. * A produção de açúcar dos Estados Unidos foi revisada para baixo na sexta-feira pelo USDA, que também revisou para baixo a safra de açúcar da União Europeia. * O contrato de açúcar branco fechou com alta de US$1,40, ou 0,3%, a US$542,50 por tonelada métrica. O mercado registrou um ganho semanal de 2%. CACAU * O cacau em Londres fechou com alta de 13 libras, ou 0,3%, a 4.246 libras por tonelada. O mercado de cacau de Londres ficou estável na semana. * Os corretores afirmaram que o cacau continuou sendo pressionado pelo grande excedente global na safra 2025/26. * Eles observaram que os dados de moagem do terceiro trimestre, a serem divulgados na próxima semana, devem ser o foco no curto prazo, com os relatórios da Europa e da América do Norte previstos para 15 de outubro. * A moagem brasileira no terceiro trimestre subiu 16,4% em relação ao ano passado, para 53.743 toneladas, informou na sexta-feira o grupo setorial AIPC. * O contrato de cacau de Nova York ficou praticamente inalterado, a US$5.665 a tonelada. Ele também ficou estável na semana. CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em queda de 2,1 centavos, ou 0,7%, a US$2,8695 por libra-peso, a menor cotação da semana. O mercado de arábica registrou queda de 0,6% na semana. * Os corretores afirmaram que o forte ritmo das exportações do Brasil, principal produtor, estava mantendo os preços sob controle, apesar das preocupações de que o fenômeno climático El Niño reduza a produção global na safra de 2027/28. * "Há uma tensão genuína em torno desse tema", afirmou a Cazarini Trading Company sobre o El Niño, acrescentando que, até o momento, as safras estão bem no Brasil, mas o período entre o final de outubro e meados de janeiro será crucial. * O café robusta subiu 1,4%, para US$3.470 a tonelada. (Reportagem de Nigel Hunt e Marcelo Teixeira)

item.title: TKO offers $2 billion for Service Properties Trust's hotel portfolio
item.description: Hospitality investment firm TKO LLC said on Thursday it had submitted a $2 billion all-cash offer to acquire the hospitality portfolio of Service Properties Trust , in a deal that would provide the real estate investment trust with liquidity to reduce debt.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hospitality investment firm TKO LLC said on Thursday it had submitted a $2 billion all-cash offer to acquire the hospitality portfolio of Service Properties Trust (SVC.O) , in a deal that would provide the real estate investment trust with liquidity to reduce debt. Shares of Service Properties Trust were up more than 15% in afternoon trading. Hotel REIT Service Properties Trust is among the few companies with significant exposure to both hotels and net-lease real estate. The company owned 93 hotels and 745 net-lease properties as of June 30, with the latter providing a steadier stream of rental income than its lodging business The deal comes at a time when hotel REITs remain more sensitive to shifts in travel demand and the broader economy, with earnings largely driven by occupancy levels and room rates TKO's offer exceeds Service Properties Trust's current market value and would allow the REIT to focus on its net-lease retail business while reducing debt TKO said its proposal would enable Service Properties Trust to pay down more than 40% of its debt, while preserving its net-lease business. The offer remains subject to negotiations and approval by Service Properties' board

item.title: Autoridades dos EUA defendem tiros contra homem em Nova York e criticam as políticas de “santuário”
item.description: Autoridades de imigração dos Estados Unidos defenderam, nesta sexta-feira, os agentes federais que atiraram e feriram um homem da cidade de Nova York dentro de seu carro, com uma criança pequena no banco de trás, e repreenderam o prefeito Zohran Mamdani por sua condenação aos agentes de imigração.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Allen, Joseph Ax
item.content:encoded: Autoridades de imigração dos Estados Unidos defenderam, nesta sexta-feira, os agentes federais que atiraram e feriram um homem da cidade de Nova York dentro de seu carro, com uma criança pequena no banco de trás, e repreenderam o prefeito Zohran Mamdani por sua condenação aos agentes de imigração. O secretário de Segurança Interna dos EUA, Markwayne Mullin, disse em uma coletiva de imprensa que os policiais não sabiam que a criança estava no carro no momento em que abriram fogo e acusou o homem, um dominicano que era o alvo da operação, de colocar em risco tanto os policiais quanto a criança. O homem, identificado pelas autoridades como Oscar Belgal, recusou-se a sair do carro quando abordado por agentes do Serviço de Imigração e Alfândega na tarde de quinta-feira em Marble Hill, bairro mais ao norte de Manhattan. Antes de Belgal, agentes federais de imigração haviam atirado em pelo menos 21 pessoas, matando 7 delas, em todo o território dos EUA desde que o presidente Donald Trump reassumiu o cargo em janeiro de 2025, prometendo recordes de deportações. Marcos Charles, autoridade de alto escalão do ICE, disse na coletiva de imprensa que Belgal acelerou o carro e bateu em dois veículos do ICE, parecendo estar “indo em direção aos agentes” quando eles começaram a atirar. Em outros incidentes violentos, os relatos iniciais do ICE ou do Departamento de Segurança Interna foram repetidamente contraditos por vídeos e outras evidências, às vezes em tribunal, e a Reuters não conseguiu verificar a versão de Charles. Belgal sofreu um ferimento superficial no pescoço, disse Charles. Ele está detido em um centro de detenção nos arredores do Estado de Nova York. O filho de 5 anos de Belgal estava no banco de trás no momento, segundo a polícia. Em um vídeo de três minutos gravado por uma câmera corporal divulgado pelo Departamento de Polícia de Nova York nesta sexta-feira, Belgal pode ser visto sentado ao lado de um carro, com as mãos algemadas atrás das costas e manchas do que parecia ser sangue fresco na pista, e com agentes à paisana em volta dele. Um deles segura um fuzil e usa um colete refletivo fluorescente. Uma multidão de curiosos enfurecidos, reunida do lado de fora de uma loja de esquina, grita com os policiais da calçada. Vários policiais municipais pegam Belgal pelos braços e pelas pernas, colocam-no no carro e o levam para um hospital. Mullin disse que o vídeo das câmeras corporais dos agentes do ICE também deve ser divulgado. Belgal é um dominicano que está no país ilegalmente e já havia escapado de uma tentativa dos agentes do ICE de prendê-lo em setembro, segundo autoridades norte-americanas. Ele se declarou culpado no ano passado por furto qualificado de quarto grau, o que resultou em uma sentença de cinco anos de liberdade condicional, e deve comparecer ao tribunal em dezembro sob a acusação de venda criminosa de substância controlada, da qual se declarou inocente, de acordo com registros judiciais de Nova York. Ao falar com jornalistas na noite de quinta-feira no local do tiroteio, Mamdani, ressaltando que ele próprio era imigrante, condenou o ICE como “podre até a medula” e disse que havia tentado, sem sucesso, garantir a libertação de Belgal em ligações telefônicas com Trump e Mullin. Mamdani afirmou que o tiroteio é “mais uma confirmação devastadora do que já sabemos há muito tempo: que o ICE age com impunidade, que semeia o caos e o terror por todo o nosso país e que já matou muito mais vizinhos nossos do que jamais poderia alegar ter salvado”. Em resposta, nesta sexta-feira, Mullin atacou Mamdani e criticou as políticas de “santuário” de Nova York, que restringem o grau de cooperação das agências municipais e da polícia com as autoridades de imigração, a menos que uma pessoa tenha sido condenada por crimes violentos ou graves. Trump afirma que esforços agressivos para deportar imigrantes são necessários para proteger a segurança dos norte-americanos nascidos no país. Defensores públicos de órgãos que representaram Belgal no tribunal também condenaram o tiroteio. A Legal Aid afirmou em um comunicado que o tiroteio representa “um apelo urgente para coibir o uso da força pelo ICE e responsabilizar os agentes federais de imigração”, exortando os promotores municipais a investigarem os agentes envolvidos.

item.title: Dental firm vVardis reveals revenue surge in US IPO filing
item.description: Dental firm vVardis on Friday revealed a more than threefold rise in first-half revenue in its filing for an initial public offering in the US.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dental firm vVardis on Friday revealed a more than threefold rise in first-half revenue in its filing for an initial public offering in the US. Here are some more details: The Zug, Switzerland-based company had a net loss of $27.8 million on revenue of $28.6 million for the six months ended June 30 2026, compared to a net loss of $32.1 million on revenue of $9.1 million, a year ago. vVardis, founded by dentists and sisters Haley Abivardi and Goly Abivardi, develops non-invasive treatments for early-stage cavities. The filing comes as the US IPO market remains selective after a strong start to the year, with investors scrutinizing valuations more closely. However, analysts say healthcare and pharmaceutical companies have remained largely insulated from broader macroeconomic uncertainty. Medical device maker Centinel Spine also [USN:L4N45T1KE TEXT:"filed"] for an IPO on Wednesday. vVardis said its products had been sold to more than 20,000 of the roughly 110,000 general dental practices in the United States as of June 30. It counts healthcare investor OrbiMed, Heartland Dental and affiliates of Apollo Global Management among its backers. It plans to use IPO proceeds for purposes that include working capital, operating expenses and capital expenditures. Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, William Blair, UBS Investment Bank, Deutsche Bank Securities, Apollo Global Securities are the underwriters for the offering. It plans to list its shares on NYSE under the symbol "VVVV".

item.title: Lawmaker calls for US research funding curbs on more Chinese schools
item.description: A Republican lawmaker has called on the Defense Department to put US research funding restrictions on dozens more Chinese universities, including one with ties to top American business leaders.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: A Republican lawmaker has called on the Defense Department to put US research funding restrictions on dozens more Chinese universities, including one with ties to top American business leaders. Representative from Michigan John Moolenaar, who chairs the House Select Committee on China, this month asked the department to add 58 more Chinese schools and 62 Chinese technology labs to what is known as the 1286 list, according to a copy of the letter seen by Reuters. Several of the Chinese labs and schools focus on areas such as semiconductors, AI and quantum computing, the letter said. The Defense Department, which President Donald Trump calls the War Department, is barred from providing research funding to any entity that works with Chinese universities on the list. It calls collaboration with listed schools "a compliance risk" that puts US federal funding at risk. The department in August said it would investigate 30 US schools around whether they collaborate with Chinese institutions on the 1286 list. Among the schools Moolenaar asked the Defense Department to include is Tsinghua University, a top Chinese school that has educated many of the country's business and political elite. Some US business leaders, including the chief executives of Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Apple and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) , [USN:FWN4241BF TEXT:"serve on the advisory board"] at Tsinghua's business school, postings that are [USN:KBN1X119Q TEXT:"meant to foster ties"] between US and Chinese companies. Nvidia declined to comment, and Tsinghua, Apple and AMD did not respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Anthropic AI model submits false homicide tip to police website
item.description: An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false homicide tip through a Philadelphia police website, the department said in a statement, the latest incident of an AI model going rogue and behaving with unintended consequences.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false homicide tip through a Philadelphia police website, the department said in a statement, the latest incident of an AI model going rogue and behaving with unintended consequences. Anthropic notified the police earlier this week and said that an automated testing process was responsible for the submission, according to the police. "The submission was flagged as spam and was never forwarded to the Real-Time Crime Center for investigative vetting or dissemination," the police said, adding that Anthropic had told them the company intended to publish a report on the incident on Friday. Anthropic did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The fast-advancing technology has become a matter of keen national interest amid reports of AI agents running amok and hacking into corporate computer networks, and warnings from prominent researchers that it could one day pose an existential threat to humanity. The AI company was cited as telling the authorities the testing process was stopped after the incident was uncovered, and that an additional validation mechanism has been introduced for future testing.

item.title: Plantio de soja de MT registra salto na semana e fica adiantado, diz Imea
item.description: O plantio de soja de Mato Grosso na safra 2026/27 atingiu 33,28% da área projetada, avanço semanal de 23,04 pontos percentuais, permitindo que o Estado afastasse um atraso inicial registrado na semana passada, de acordo com dados do Instituto Mato-grossense de Economia Agropecuária (Imea), publicados nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O plantio de soja de Mato Grosso na safra 2026/27 atingiu 33,28% da área projetada, avanço semanal de 23,04 pontos percentuais, permitindo que o Estado afastasse um [USN:L1N45O0UE TEXT:"atraso"] inicial registrado na semana passada, de acordo com dados do Instituto Mato-grossense de Economia Agropecuária (Imea), publicados nesta sexta-feira. O ritmo de plantio de soja no principal produtor brasileiro agora supera o índice da mesma época do ano passado (21,22%) e a média histórica de cinco anos para o período (25,36%), segundo o órgão ligado aos produtores, que contaram com mais chuvas para avançar nos trabalhos. "As chuvas também favoreceram a aceleração dos trabalhos a campo nas regiões Sudeste e Nordeste. No Noroeste, por outro lado, a falta de precipitações continua limitando o ritmo, com a semeadura concentrada principalmente em Brasnorte, na divisa com a região Oeste", afirmou o Imea em nota. No início da semana, o instituto manteve as projeções de área, produtividade e produção de soja de Mato Grosso, projetando uma safra de cerca de [USN:L1N45R0XX TEXT:"49 milhões de toneladas"] em 13,05 milhões de hectares. A aceleração dos trabalhos com a soja é importante para as culturas de segunda safra se desenvolverem dentro da melhor janela climática. O percentual plantado com soja é semelhante ao registrado no mesmo período da safra 2023/24, disse o Imea. Em relação à mesma época do ano passado, há uma aceleração, mas o instituto ponderou que a estiagem limitou o avanço dos trabalhos no início do ciclo 2025/26.

item.title: Exportação de café do Brasil cresce 3% em setembro apesar de queda nos embarques de arábica
item.description: A exportação de café verde do Brasil aumentou 3,2% em setembro na comparação com o mesmo período do ano anterior, para 3,58 milhões de sacas de 60 kg, com embarques menores de grãos arábica limitando o crescimento, afirmou o Conselho dos Exportadores de Café do Brasil (Cecafé) nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A exportação de café verde do Brasil aumentou 3,2% em setembro na comparação com o mesmo período do ano anterior, para 3,58 milhões de sacas de 60 kg, com embarques menores de grãos arábica limitando o crescimento, afirmou o Conselho dos Exportadores de Café do Brasil (Cecafé) nesta sexta-feira. Os embarques totais foram impulsionados pelo café canéfora (robusta e conilon), que tiveram aumento de 65,1% para 813,9 mil sacas. Já os grãos arábica tiveram queda de 7,1% na exportação, para 2,766 milhões de sacas. "Além do cenário mercadológico, o fato de termos uma safra de arábica mais prejudicada em qualidade resulta em menores preços para esses cafés afetados, principalmente pela chuva", disse o presidente do Cecafé, Márcio Ferreira. Embora o Brasil tenha colhido uma safra recorde em 2026, segundo estimativas oficiais e de analistas, a qualidade da safra de arábica ficou aquém do desejável, por conta de chuvas durante o período de colheita. Somando o café industrializado, especialmente o solúvel, as exportações totais atingiram 3,89 milhões de sacas, avanço de 3,1%, apontou o Cecafé. O presidente do Cecafé citou ainda que o crescimento nas exportações em setembro reflete a retomada das remessas aos Estados Unidos após o término das incertezas com a exclusão das tarifas impostas sobre os cafés do Brasil em julho passado. "Em novembro de 2025, os EUA retiraram a taxação sobre a maior parte do produto brasileiro, mas, até julho deste ano, o café solúvel seguia tarifado", lembrou Ferreira. Com o fim das tarifas, os EUA voltaram a ser o maior importador de café brasileiro. Em setembro deste ano, os EUA importaram 625.192 sacas de todos os tipos de café do Brasil, o que implica um incremento de 86,4% na comparação com o mesmo mês do ano anterior. Com a retomada das importações em agosto e setembro, os EUA ultrapassaram a Alemanha e retomaram a liderança entre os principais destinos das exportações no acumulado dos nove primeiros meses deste ano, detalhou o conselho. Os norte-americanos adquiriram 3,805 milhões de sacas no período, volume ainda 12,8% inferior ao aferido no mesmo intervalo em 2025.

item.title: Productores de petróleo del golfo de México suspenden faenas ante proximidad de huracán
item.description: Los productores estadounidenses del golfo de México suspendieron la producción de unos 1,5 millones de barriles diarios de petróleo y 1.300 millones de pies cúbicos diarios de gas natural, lo que supone un aumento respecto del jueves, mientras el huracán Isaías avanzaba hacia la costa antes de su llegada prevista al Panhandle de Florida a última hora del viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los productores estadounidenses del golfo de México suspendieron la producción de unos 1,5 millones de barriles diarios de petróleo y 1.300 millones de pies cúbicos diarios de gas natural, lo que supone un aumento respecto del jueves, mientras el huracán Isaías avanzaba hacia la costa antes de su llegada prevista al Panhandle de Florida a última hora del viernes. Las suspensiones representan casi el 72% y el 59% de la producción de petróleo y gas natural de Estados Unidos en el golfo de México, respectivamente, según la Administración de Minerales Marinos. Se ha evacuado al personal de 129 plataformas de producción, lo que representa el 35% de las 371 plataformas con personal en el golfo de México, informó la agencia. Añadió que también se había evacuado a las tripulaciones de ocho plataformas sin posicionamiento dinámico. La zona federal de alta mar del golfo de México produce unos 2 millones de barriles de petróleo al día, según la Administración de Información Energética de Estados Unidos, lo que supone aproximadamente el 15% de la producción total de crudo del país. La región también produce un promedio de unos 2.100 millones de pies cúbicos diarios de gas natural. Isaías, el primer huracán de la temporada atlántica de 2026, se ha intensificado hasta convertirse en uno de categoría 3 y se desplaza hacia el norte-noreste. Se espera que se debilite tras tocar tierra, según el Centro Nacional de Huracanes. El huracán podría interrumpir la producción de unos 7,2 millones de barriles de petróleo en el Golfo, según Earth Science Associates. La consultora rebajó su previsión desde 9 millones de barriles del jueves, al observarse que la trayectoria prevista de la tormenta se desplazaba hacia el este. Entre las empresas más expuestas a la tormenta están BP (BP.L) , Chevron (CVX.N) , ENI (ENI.MI) , Murphy Oil (MUR.N) y Shell (SHEL.L) , entre otras, según el modelo de Earth Science. Según estimaciones de Energy Aspects, unos 500.000 barriles de capacidad diaria de refino se encuentran en la trayectoria de la tormenta, incluida la refinería de Pascagoula, en Misisipi.

item.title: MBRF Pet inicia exportação aos EUA em busca do maior mercado para rações de cães e gatos
item.description: A MBRF Pet, divisão de ração para animais de estimação do grupo MBRF , iniciou exportações de alimentos úmidos de maior valor agregado para o mercado dos Estados Unidos, que respondem por mais de 40% do faturamento global desse setor, disse um executivo à Reuters nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Roberto Samora
item.content:encoded: A MBRF Pet, divisão de ração para animais de estimação do grupo MBRF (MBRF3.SA) , iniciou exportações de alimentos úmidos de maior valor agregado para o mercado dos Estados Unidos, que respondem por mais de 40% do faturamento global desse setor, disse um executivo à Reuters nesta sexta-feira. Comercializando pouco mais de 3 bilhões de porções para alimentar cães e gatos ao ano, a companhia está entre as líderes no mercado do Brasil, o terceiro mercado global, atrás também da China. Mas a empresa conta ainda com o mercado de forte crescimento de exportação para expandir negócios. "A entrada nos Estados Unidos representa um marco na estratégia de internacionalização da MBRF Pet", disse o diretor da MBRF Pet, Stanley Andrade. A agregação do mercado norte-americano tem potencial de impulsionar as vendas externas da companhia, que viu crescimento de 18% no exterior neste ano. A empresa vende para 20 mercados atualmente, ante 15 há dois anos, enquanto projeta ampliar os destinos externos para 26 até o final de 2027. Para vendas aos EUA, a companhia já conta com duas das cinco unidades habilitadas, uma delas em Bastos (SP) e a outra em Doctor Juan León Mallorquín, no Paraguai, próximo de Foz do Iguaçu (PR). A MBRF Pet não detalha seus dados financeiros. Mas o executivo ressaltou que o segmento de "pet food" deve faturar no Brasil R$42,96 bilhões em 2026, segundo projeção da Associação Brasileira das Empresas do Setor de Animais de Estimação (Abempet). Já as vendas externas do setor somaram R$3,3 bilhões em 2025, crescimento de 12% em relação ao ano anterior, conforme a Abempet A empresa, cujas vendas fora do Brasil (incluindo exportações) representam quase 20% do total faturado pela unidade de pet, tem no Chile, Paraguai e Uruguai seus principais mercados externos. Nos EUA, a estratégia é de "entrar de forma gradual", enquanto esse destino deve ser prioritário no futuro. "Neste mercado, não tem objetivo (inicial) de acelerar demais, a gente tem que criar marca, tem que estar nas prateleiras, com alimentos úmidos, depois (vendendo) alimentos secos via Paraguai", afirmou, sem estabelecer uma meta. A companhia chegou a avaliar no passado a venda da unidade de rações para pet, surgida após aquisições há vários anos. Mas esse processo de alienação foi encerrado em 2023. Agora, disse o executivo, o foco é crescer organicamente, e não há intenção de aquisições por enquanto. "Temos plano de chegar à liderança pela internacionalização e agregação de valor", ressaltou ele. O segmento de ração para pets tem sinergias importantes com a produção de carnes da MBRF, uma das maiores companhias de alimentos do mundo, que utiliza na ração animal produtos como farinha de frango e de suínos e gorduras como ingredientes, entre outros.

item.title: LSU lists 10 players on roster for exhibition after months with just 4
item.description: After listing just four players in its program as late as Wednesday, LSU men's basketball had 10 players available for an exhibition Thursday night at McNeese State.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: After listing just four players in its program as late as Wednesday, LSU men's basketball had 10 players available for an exhibition Thursday night at McNeese State. The Tigers' roster was just four-deep for months as coach Will Wade worked to reconstruct the program in his return to Baton Rouge. Wade said in September that the roster was up to 13, but he didn't list all the names, with the speculation being that eligibility questions prevented players from being identified. In fact, Wade said after Thursday's 63-60 Tigers win that one of his starters (later reported as Michael Ruzic) was declared eligible at 3:30 p.m., just hours before tipoff in Lake Charles, La. Wade played just seven players in the victory: starters Ruzic, Kentucky transfer Mouhamed Dioubate, Kansas State transfer Abdi Bashir Jr., UCLA transfer Donovan Dent, Michigan State transfer Divine Ugochukwu and freshman reserves Jordan Bender and Strake Pearson. Wade said that he held out two rotation players so as not to "poke the bear." "We have another two that are cleared to play, but we wanted to make sure all the paperwork was final before we did it. We were not trying to do anything untoward towards any acronym (i.e., the NCAA and SEC). So, we were extra cautious," Wade said, per The Advocate. Wade said the paperwork on one of those players was submitted late Thursday and that the player should be cleared by Friday. One player whose status remained uncertain is St. John's transfer RJ Luis, who did not make the trip Thursday. Luis has NBA experience in camps with the Utah Jazz and Boston Celtics, playing in preseason games for Boston. He joined a lawsuit filed in Louisiana against the NCAA to return to college, and the judge in the case granted the plaintiffs eligibility. Luis signed with LSU in May. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled out vs. Falcons
item.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was ruled out for Baltimore's Week 5 game Sunday night against the Atlanta Falcons.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was ruled out for Baltimore's Week 5 game Sunday night against the Atlanta Falcons. Head coach Jesse Minter said Friday that Tyler Huntley would be the starter at Atlanta (2-2). Jackson did not practice all week because of a left ankle injury that forced him to leave last week's win over the Titans before halftime. Huntley filled in when Jackson was hurt and completed 8 of 9 passes for 63 yards in the second half as the Ravens defeated the Titans 24-18. "We have a ton of confidence in (Huntley) to play really well," Minter said. "I think everyone on the team is excited to see that." Minter initially said the Ravens (3-1) could still use Jackson if he was unable to practice all week, but a rugged schedule ahead likely led Baltimore to play it safe for another week. The Ravens are 6-11 in the previous 17 games Jackson missed. Baltimore was 2-2 last season without him. Huntley has started 11 games in place of Jackson and has a 5-6 record, including 2-0 in 2025. Jackson, 29, is 68-of-96 passing (70.8%) for 967 yards, six touchdowns and one interception in four games (all starts) this season. The four-time Pro Bowl selection is a three-time first-team All-Pro honoree and was the NFL Most Valuable Player in 2019 and 2023. Huntley, 28, has passed for 3,275 yards, 13 TDs and 10 interceptions in 31 regular-season games (16 starts) for the Ravens (2020-23, 2025-present) and Miami Dolphins (2024). He also has played in two postseason games (one start) for Baltimore and completed 23 of 42 passes for 286 yards, two TDs and one pick. --Field Level Media

item.title: Vance says he does not know if Pentagon will proceed with livestream of Fort Hood gunman's execution
item.description: Amid broad condemnation, Vice President JD Vance's comments raises questions over the extent of opposition within the Trump administration to the Pentagon's plans to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan.
item.dc:creator: Phil Stewart, Bo Erickson
item.content:encoded: Vice President JD Vance said on Friday he does not know whether the Pentagon will carry out its plan to livestream the execution by firing squad of the former US Army psychiatrist convicted in the deadly 2009 Fort Hood shooting, a plan that has drawn broad condemnation. As the controversy over the plan championed by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth grew, former US officials said a livestream of the execution would hand terrorists a recruiting tool, while a top US Catholic bishop called the plan "barbaric." "I don't know that that's actually going to happen," Vance told reporters in Cincinnati, referring to a livestream. Vance added that if a livestream of the execution scheduled for December 3 occurs, "I'm not going to be watching it." The No. 2 US official's comments raise questions about the extent of opposition within President Donald Trump 's administration to the Pentagon's plans to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, who was found guilty in a US military trial of killing 13 people at Fort Hood in Texas. Trump on Friday said at a White House event that Hasan deserves the death penalty by firing squad, calling him "a maniac." The Republican president has not said whether he thinks the event should be shown on a livestream. Death penalty experts said it would mark the first-known broadcast or livestream of a lawful execution. 'FOR ALL TO SEE' Hegseth, a Trump appointee, said on Thursday the public nature of the execution would demonstrate "there's serious consequences for these types of things." Hegseth reposted a comment Trump made in 2013, possibly about the Boston Marathon bombers, saying: "Should be public execution for all to see — you will end this bullshit fast!" The Pentagon on Friday declined to say whether families of those killed in Hasan's attack would be invited to attend the execution, as is common practice in civilian executions. It remains unclear how the Army would select the shooters and what protocols might be followed during the execution itself. The Pentagon said it would release details later. A top US Catholic official condemned the plan. "This decision is a barbaric promotion of a culture of death and must be reconsidered," said Archbishop Paul Coakley, president of the United States Conference of Catholic Bishops. The Catholic Church opposes capital punishment. Vance, a convert to Catholicism, has written a book about his faith. Hegseth, a member of a conservative evangelical denomination, has invoked Christian language when discussing the Iran war and has led prayer services at the Pentagon. Hegseth has brushed off Pope Leo's criticism of the war. Hasan is set to become the first person to be executed by [USN:L1N45S037 TEXT:"firing squad"] by the US military since 1945. Hasan, an American-born Muslim, said during his 2013 trial that he carried out the shootings to try to stop what he called a US war on Islam. "Whatever the controversy is about the method of the execution, I hope that people don't forget that this is a guy who brutally murdered a lot of innocent people," Vance told reporters. 'FREE PROPAGANDA' Joe Kent, who resigned this year as Trump's head of the National Counterterrorism Center, said the effort to deter extremism by livestreaming the execution could backfire. "Streaming his execution is not just a stain on our morality — it also gives the terrorists free propaganda that they will use to radicalize & recruit more terrorists," Kent wrote on social media. Republican Senator Thom Tillis wrote on social media that Hasan should be put to death, but that livestreaming his execution would be "beyond disgusting" and something that "oppressive dictatorships like Iran and Afghanistan do." Senator Jack Reed, the top Democrat on the Senate Armed Services Committee and a former Army officer, said such a livestream would give the shooter more attention. "This is a gift to anti-American terrorist recruiters. It is absolutely shameful and damaging to America's interests and core values," Reed said in a statement. The UN human rights office condemned the decision. "Public executions constitute a form of cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment," Shabia Mantoo, a spokesperson for the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, told a news briefing in Geneva. Mantoo added that it would "breach the absolute prohibition of torture." DECISION AMID DEBATE The decision to livestream the execution comes at a time of heightened debate in the United States over the death penalty following the [USN:L1N45M04O TEXT:"botched lethal injection"] last week of a Tennessee woman who was sentenced to death for a 1995 murder. The controversy has flared in the run-up to the November 3 US midterm elections, with polls indicating Trump's party could lose control of the House of Representatives and possibly the Senate to the opposition Democrats. The execution is scheduled to be held at the same sprawling military base where Hasan opened fire with a handgun in a medical facility. A military jury sentenced Hasan to death after finding him guilty of 45 counts of premeditated murder and attempted premeditated murder. The shooting came weeks before Hasan, now 56, was scheduled to be deployed with US forces to Afghanistan. Hasan was left partially paralyzed and confined to a wheelchair from being shot by police during his arrest. The group Death Penalty Action, which opposes capital punishment, said Hasan's execution would be the first military execution since 1961, which was carried out by hanging. The last known executions by US military firing squads were in 1945, the Death Penalty Information Center said. At least five states have firing squads on the books, according to the Death Penalty Information Center, and in 2025 [USN:L2N3PP0X8 TEXT:"South Carolina"] carried out the first such execution in the United States in 15 years.

item.title: Trump dice que Rusia suministrará de inmediato diésel a los mercados de EEUU y el mundo
item.description: El presidente Donald Trump dijo el viernes que Rusia había acordado suministrar de forma inmediata más de 300.000 toneladas de gasóleo al mercado estadounidense y mundial, en un intento por reducir los precios del combustible antes de las elecciones de legislativas de noviembre.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: El presidente Donald Trump dijo el viernes que Rusia había acordado suministrar de forma inmediata más de 300.000 toneladas de gasóleo al mercado estadounidense y mundial, en un intento por reducir los precios del combustible antes de las elecciones de legislativas de noviembre. La medida se anuncia en un momento en que los precios del diésel -que se usa en la agricultura, la calefacción doméstica y el transporte de mercancías- se sitúan cerca de máximos históricos, antes de las elecciones del 3 de noviembre, que determinarán que partido controlará el Congreso. Trump dijo en una publicación en las redes sociales que había tenido una conversación "muy satisfactoria" con el presidente Vladimir Putin, en la que acordaron que Rusia suministraría el gasóleo de forma inmediata. Un enviado de Putin, Kirill Dmitriev, elogió la cooperación entre Rusia y Estados Unidos en materia de diésel y energía en una publicación en X el viernes, poco después de la conversación telefonica. Trump añadio que Rusia suministraría otras 500.000 toneladas en noviembre y otro millón de toneladas "inmediatamente después". Según Trump, llegarían aún más después de eso, "en función del estado de sus refinerías de gasóleo", que han resultado dañadas por los ataques durante la guerra de Rusia contra Ucrania. La inusual medida coincide con la imposición de sanciones estadounidenses a las empresas energéticas rusas por su guerra contra Ucrania, que comenzó en febrero de 2022. El Departamento del Tesoro emitió el viernes una licencia general que permite la importación de diésel ruso hasta el 7 de abril del próximo año. Los precios del gasóleo, que pueden impulsar la inflación, han subido un 70% desde que comenzó este año la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán, a pesar de dos medidas recientes de gran repercusión adoptadas por Trump para impulsar el suministro de este combustible: presionar a los aliados para que liberen reservas de emergencia y ampliar el acceso al diésel teñido de rojo, exento de impuestos, que normalmente se usa para maquinaria agrícola. "La reducción de los precios para los estadounidenses, especialmente para nuestros grandes agricultores, ganaderos y camioneros, es mi máxima prioridad", dijo Trump.

item.title: Moldova to change laws to produce arms for itself, parliament head says
item.description: Moldova's pro-European government intends to press for changes in legislation to allow for the production of weapons, but needs them for its own defence and has no intention of providing them to neighbouring Ukraine, the head of parliament said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Tanas
item.content:encoded: Moldova's pro-European government intends to press for changes in legislation to allow for the production of weapons, but needs them for its own defence and has no intention of providing them to neighbouring Ukraine, the head of parliament said on Friday. Parliament Chairman Igor Grosu, the No. 2 official in Moldova's state hierarchy, said the changes were needed to proceed with the manufacture of dual-purpose weapons, like drones. "I would very much like for us to produce them for ourselves. We need them, particularly for dual-use purposes," Grosu told a two-day international security forum, citing drone use for national security, emergencies and agriculture. Grosu, head of President Maia Sandu's Action and Solidarity Party, which holds a majority in parliament, dismissed any suggestion that they might be meant for use by Ukraine in its 4-1/2-year-old war with Russia . "Of course not! Why would we?" he told reporters. "We would produce them for ourselves." Sandu's administration, which wants Moldova to join the European Union by 2030, has been fiercely critical of Moscow's invasion of Ukraine. Moldova, lying between Ukraine and EU member Romania, has been buffeted by the war. Increasing numbers of drones and missiles, believed by authorities to be Russian, have intruded into the country's airspace in recent weeks, with debris crashing on its territory. Grosu told the forum that 88 such violations of Moldova's airspace had been recorded since Russia's February 2022 invasion. "With such figures, people are asking a simple question: Can our state defend us?" he said. "We cannot provide this defence overnight. And we cannot in four years make up for 30 years of failing to finance our defence. To protect our airspace we need radar, equipment, trained personnel, communications, infrastructure and procedures." Sandu told the forum on Thursday that Moldova's position in the region was "vulnerable". She said domestic defence production was a key part of future defence planning and changes to legislation would soon be submitted to parliament.

item.title: Trump says Russia to immediately supply 300,000 tons of diesel fuel
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to immediately supply over 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to the American and global marketplace after what Trump described as a "highly successful" discussion with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to immediately supply over 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to the American and global marketplace after what Trump described as a "highly successful" discussion with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Trump added that Russia would then deliver 3 million tons of diesel fuel within a short period of time, based on the condition of its diesel refineries, and would immediately supply another 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons immediately thereafter.

item.title: Port of Los Angeles sets September volume record, executive director says
item.description: The Port of Los Angeles, the busiest in the US for containers, set a volume record in September as holiday goods hit docks, ships were routed away from the drought-stricken Panama Canal and importers picked the shortest route from China to reduce use of pricey fuel, Executive Director Gene Seroka said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Lisa Baertlein
item.content:encoded: The Port of Los Angeles, the busiest in the US for containers, set a volume record in September as holiday goods hit docks, ships were routed away from the drought-stricken Panama Canal and importers picked the shortest route from China to reduce use of pricey fuel, Executive Director Gene Seroka said on Friday. Workers at the facility handled 1.04 million 20-foot equivalent units (TEUs) during the month. Loaded containers accounted for almost 547,000 TEUs, also a new record, Seroka said. Experts view US import data as an indicator of national economic health, consumer demand and reactions to trade policies. "Tariffs are lower than the levels we saw earlier this year and last, giving importers more certainty on costs and allowing them to replenish inventories at a quicker rate," Seroka said of US import levies that have disrupted trade. Total US container imports hit 2.55 million TEUs in September, a record for the month, according to supply-chain technology provider Descartes Systems (DSG.TO) . US consumers have continued to spend, even as prices for necessities like food and energy have marched higher. Retailers account for roughly 50% of container volume, and the National Retail Federation forecast total 2026 retail sales of $5.6 trillion, up 4.4% from last year. Shipments of equipment related to artificial intelligence projects, including components used to cool data centers, also are booming. The surge in demand, however, has not benefited all container ports equally. Some ships from Asia have shifted to the West Coast from the East Coast due to restrictions on the Panama Canal shortcut, said Seroka, who added that the West Coast route is the fastest for trade with that export powerhouse. The Los Angeles port covers 7,500 acres (about 3,000 hectares) of combined land and water and lately has handled more containers than it did during the COVID-19 shipping surge, without the bottlenecks that led to more than 100 ships waiting to enter. The port will process about 900,000 TEUs in October, said Seroka, who added that most holiday merchandise should be in the country by November. While the near-term outlook for trade at the port remains strong, risks remain, he said. "What could cause it to change? Another social media post or announcement on trade from Washington that could create some sort of uncertainty once again."

item.title: Pennsylvania says GSK to invest more than $800 million in biopharma hub, create 300 jobs
item.description: GSK will invest more than $800 million to expand its Upper Merion, Pennsylvania site into a new biopharmaceutical manufacturing and research hub, creating more than 300 jobs over the next five years, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro's office said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: GSK (GSK.L) will invest more than $800 million to expand its Upper Merion, Pennsylvania site into a new biopharmaceutical manufacturing and research hub, creating more than 300 jobs over the next five years, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro's office said on Friday. The investment will establish a site that combines drug manufacturing, research and development, quality testing and digital operations in Montgomery County. GSK said construction is planned to begin in 2027 and the project will support both clinical and commercial production of biologic medicines. The expansion is expected to create more than 300 new jobs and retain about 4,500 existing full-time jobs in Pennsylvania. The company said the project will include a new commercial-scale biologics manufacturing facility, a research pilot plant and a centralized quality-control laboratory. Pennsylvania officials said GSK will be eligible for state manufacturing tax incentives tied to the investment. The Upper Merion expansion and GSK's previously announced Lancaster County facility project together represent nearly $1.7 billion of planned investment in Pennsylvania, according to state officials. GSK, whose U.S. headquarters is in Philadelphia, said the expansion will help accelerate the development and supply of future medicines.

item.title: Le Panama frappé par un puissant séisme, des dégâts signalés
item.description: Le Panama a été frappé vendredi par un puissant séisme qui a endommagé des habitations sans que des victimes soient signalées dans l'immédiat par les autorités.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le Panama a été frappé vendredi par un puissant séisme qui a endommagé des habitations sans que des victimes soient signalées dans l'immédiat par les autorités. L'institut américain de veille géologique (USGS) a évalué la magnitude à 8,0 sur l'échelle de Richter avant de la rétrograder à 7,7. Il a diffusé une alerte au tsunami pour la côte Pacifique de l'Amérique centrale ainsi que la Colombie et l'Equateur. La secousse, qui s'est produite au large de la côte sud du Panama, a été ressentie dans la capitale de même qu'à San José, la capitale du Costa Rica voisin, selon les correspondants de Reuters. Plusieurs répliques ont été enregistrées par la suite. L'épicentre du séisme était proche de la localité rurale de La Pitaloza, dans la province faiblement peuplée de Herrera, près de l'océan Pacifique. Des dégâts ont été signalés à Chitré, la capitale provinciale de Herrera, et le long de la côte dans la province de Los Santos, a déclaré le chef de l'agence de la protection civile panaméenne, Omar Smith. Des vidéos postées par le journal La Prensa montrent l'effondrement de la tour d'un bâtiment historique et de plusieurs balcons d'un immeuble résidentiel à Penonome, située à mi-chemin entre l'épicentre et Panama, la capitale, où de nombreuses personnes ont évacué précipitamment leurs habitations. Le ministère de l'Education a ordonné la fermeture des écoles dans tout le pays. L'autorité du canal de Panama a déclaré que le canal fonctionnait normalement.

item.title: SoftBank-backed OPay reveals revenue rise in US IPO filing
item.description: Africa-focused digital payments company OPay on Friday revealed in its US initial public offering filing that its revenue more than doubled in the first six months of the year.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Africa-focused digital payments company OPay on Friday revealed in its US initial public offering filing that its revenue more than doubled in the first six months of the year. The filing comes as surging bond yields and elevated interest rates dampen investor appetite for new listings, prompting several companies to delay their flotation plans. Here are some more details: The Nigeria-focused fintech company's net income rose to $90.9 million from $21.7 million a year earlier, while revenue more than doubled to $467.1 million from $197.5 million in the six months ended June 30. OPay provides digital payments and lending services across Nigeria, Indonesia, Egypt and Pakistan, allowing consumers and merchants to make payments, transfer money and access credit through its platform. OPay, founded by Chinese billionaire Yahui Zhou, raised $400 million at a $2 billion valuation in 2021. Zhou also founded Chinese gaming company Beijing Kunlun Tech Co Ltd (300418.SZ) , which was once the owner of the popular dating app Grindr. Fintech investment in Africa has grown as companies seek to serve a young, underbanked population increasingly adopting digital financial services. Stanbic Africa Holdings Limited has agreed to invest as much as $200 million in a concurrent private placement. SoftBank entities own a 6.6% stake in OPay before the offering, according to the filing. OPay plans to pursue a secondary listing in Nigeria after completing its NYSE listing. Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Standard Bank, CICC are among the underwriters for the offering. OPay has applied to list its American depositary shares on NYSE under the symbol "OPAY".

item.title: Trump retoma tentativa de demitir diretora do Fed Cook, com nova investigação da Casa Branca
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, iniciou uma nova investigação contra a diretora do Federal Reserve Lisa Cook, semanas antes das eleições para o Congresso, convocando um comitê investigativo e ordenando uma audiência sem precedentes na Casa Branca sobre as alegações de que ela teria prestado declarações falsas em pedidos de empréstimos hipotecários.
item.dc:creator: Ann Saphir
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, iniciou uma nova investigação contra a diretora do Federal Reserve Lisa Cook, semanas antes das eleições para o Congresso, convocando um comitê investigativo e ordenando uma audiência sem precedentes na Casa Branca sobre as alegações de que ela teria prestado declarações falsas em pedidos de empréstimos hipotecários. Trump vem tentando demitir Cook há mais de um ano, à medida que busca exercer maior controle sobre um banco central que, segundo ele, se recusa, por motivos políticos, a reduzir as taxas de juros. Os advogados de Cook afirmaram nesta sexta-feira que qualquer audiência justa demonstraria que não há fundamento legal para demiti-la. “Como presidente, é minha função garantir que as leis sejam fielmente cumpridas, inclusive demitindo subordinados em quem não se pode confiar para dizer a verdade e seguir a lei”, disse Trump em um comunicado publicado no site da Casa Branca nesta sexta-feira. “Para me auxiliar no cumprimento dessa responsabilidade, o comitê investigará as alegações contra a diretora Cook e me informará se há ‘motivo’ para a destituição da diretora Cook”, segundo o comunicado, datado de 7 de outubro. O comitê realizará uma audiência presencial e fechada de quatro horas na Casa Branca em 5 de novembro “para analisar as provas e as alegações contra a diretora Cook”, informou o memorando presidencial. A audiência ocorrerá dois dias após as eleições que determinarão se o Partido Republicano de Trump manterá o controle da Câmara e do Senado, cujos membros são responsáveis por confirmar os indicados presidenciais para o Fed. Uma destituição bem-sucedida de Cook criaria uma vaga na diretoria de sete membros do Fed. Se a audiência for “de alguma forma objetiva, a conclusão será de que a diretora Cook não cometeu fraude hipotecária, não havendo motivo para destituí-la da Diretoria do Federal Reserve”, afirmaram os advogados de Cook, Abbe Lowell e Norm Eisen, em comunicado. “A diretora Cook acolhe com satisfação a oportunidade de apresentar os fatos para que possa limpar seu nome e demonstrar que não há base legal para demiti-la.” Eles afirmaram ter mantido contato com a Casa Branca a respeito do processo. Trump tentou pela primeira vez demitir Cook, a primeira mulher negra a integrar a diretoria do banco central, em agosto de 2025. Nenhum presidente jamais havia tentado demitir um diretor do Fed em exercício antes. Considera-se amplamente que os bancos centrais precisam de independência política para garantir sua capacidade de combater a inflação conforme necessário. DECISÃO DA SUPREMA CORTE SOBRE A DESTITUIÇÃO NO FED Cook entrou com uma ação judicial, alegando que não havia feito nada de errado. O caso levou a uma decisão da Suprema Corte dos EUA neste ano, determinando que o presidente não poderia destituir um diretor do Fed à sua vontade, e que precisaria seguir um processo claro que estabelecesse uma “causa” para a demissão e permitisse uma defesa. A decisão manteve Cook em seu cargo, mas remeteu o processo contra ela de volta a um tribunal federal de primeira instância, onde a juíza Kia Cobb estabeleceu, no mês passado, o prazo de 6 de novembro para que os advogados de Trump e de Cook apresentassem uma proposta conjunta para o andamento do processo. Cook foi nomeada para a diretoria do Fed em 2022 pelo então presidente Joe Biden, do Partido Democrata, e foi renomeada em 2023 para um mandato que se estende até 2038. Ela sempre votou com a maioria no comitê de formulação de política monetária do Fed, que no mês passado elevou as taxas de juros sob a liderança de Kevin Warsh, nomeado por Trump para suceder Jerome Powell em maio. “Trump parece acreditar que a razão pela qual o Fed adotou uma postura mais restritiva é porque o chair por ele escolhido, Warsh, está cercado por uma Diretoria do Fed hawkish (agressiva com a inflação) e politicamente hostil”, escreveu o analista da Evercore ISI, Krishna Guha. A criação do comitê de inquérito por Trump “constitui um reforço de sua ameaça à independência do Fed e será contraproducente em relação ao desejo do presidente de taxas de juros mais baixas”. O principal assessor de política econômica de Trump, Kevin Hassett, a presidente da Comissão de Oportunidades Iguais de Emprego, Andrea Lucas, e o diretor interino do Escritório de Ética Governamental, Keith Sonderling, comporão o comitê recém-formado, segundo o memorando. Esses membros, seus representantes ou funcionários do Departamento de Justiça interrogarão Cook por “não mais do que quatro horas”. O comitê apresentará sua recomendação a Trump sobre se há motivos para destituir Cook “assim que for possível”, após o prazo de 10 de novembro para que Cook apresente qualquer declaração pós-audiência, segundo o memorando. A senadora Elizabeth Warren, principal democrata no Comitê de Bancos do Senado que supervisiona o Fed, chamou a audiência de “tribunal irregular” e parte da “perigosa tentativa de Trump de assumir ilegalmente o controle do banco central de nosso país”. Trump alegou que Powell, que permaneceu no Fed como diretor, pode ter se envolvido em irregularidades financeiras relacionadas às reformas do prédio do Fed — uma alegação que desencadeou uma investigação criminal do Departamento de Justiça, agora encerrada, e foi rejeitada no mês passado por uma agência independente de fiscalização.

item.title: REACCIONES Estados Unidos impone sanciones a la Corte Penal Internacional
item.description: El Gobierno de Donald Trump impuso sanciones a la Corte Penal Internacional (CPI) el viernes, pocas horas después de que una de sus antiguas magistradas ganó el Premio Nobel de la Paz, lo que ha situado a Washington en una trayectoria de conflicto diplomático con sus aliados europeos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno de Donald Trump impuso sanciones a la Corte Penal Internacional (CPI) el viernes, pocas horas después de que una de sus antiguas magistradas ganó el Premio Nobel de la Paz, lo que ha situado a Washington en una trayectoria de conflicto diplomático con sus aliados europeos. A continuación algunas reacciones a esta medida: CORTE PENAL INTERNACIONAL: Las sanciones constituyen "un intento de obstruir el curso de la justicia e impedir que la Corte cumpla la misión para la que fue creada. Se trata de un ataque al Estado de derecho y a los propios cimientos del orden jurídico internacional, que atenta contra el sencillo principio de que nadie está por sobre la ley". "La designación tiene por objeto perturbar el funcionamiento de la Corte e intimidar a quienes trabajan para ella o cooperan con ella. La Corte, por su parte, no se dejará intimidar (…) Sin embargo, la Corte no puede actuar en solitario. Su destino recae ahora también en manos de los Estados que la crearon". BENJAMÍN NETANYAHU, PRIMER MINISTRO ISRAELÍ: "Felicito al presidente @realDonaldTrump y a @SecRubio por tomar esta decisión crucial de sancionar a la CPI. La CPI no es un tribunal. Es un órgano político que supone una amenaza mortal para las democracias respetuosas con la ley de todo el mundo y para la propia idea de soberanía nacional", escribió Netanyahu en X. "Gracias por su liderazgo". ANTONIO GUTERRES, SECRETARIO GENERAL DE LA ONU "El secretario general condena el anuncio de Estados Unidos de imponer sanciones a la Corte Penal Internacional como institución", según un comunicado leído por el portavoz de la ONU, Stéphane Dujarric, durante una rueda de prensa. "La decisión de hoy supone un duro golpe para nuestro esfuerzo colectivo en pro de la justicia penal internacional, de la que la CPI es un pilar fundamental", añadió. COMISIÓN EUROPEA: "Es profundamente lamentable que Estados Unidos haya anunciado su intención de imponer sanciones. […] La UE está dispuesta a adoptar todas las medidas necesarias para que la Corte pueda llevar a cabo su labor, tanto en la investigación como en el enjuiciamiento de crímenes de guerra y crímenes contra la humanidad, y para proteger los intereses de los operadores de la UE dentro del mercado único". TOM BERENDSEN, MINISTRO DE ASUNTOS EXTERIORES DE LOS PAÍSES BAJOS, PAÍS SEDE DE LA CPI: "Se trata de una medida profundamente lamentable. Nos mantendremos firmes en la defensa de la Corte. Al mismo tiempo, es importante señalar que las sanciones no entren en vigor de forma inmediata y que los proveedores de servicios puedan seguir trabajando para la CPI. El plazo de seis meses antes de que las sanciones entren en vigor abre un margen para el diálogo". LOS MINISTROS DE ASUNTOS EXTERIORES DE CANADÁ, DINAMARCA, ALEMANIA, FRANCIA, ITALIA, JAPÓN, LOS PAÍSES BAJOS Y EL REINO UNIDO EN UNA DECLARACIÓN CONJUNTA: "Como firmes defensores de la CPI, lamentamos y rechazamos enérgicamente el anuncio de las sanciones que Estados Unidos impondrá a la Corte. (…) Si se aplican, estas sanciones tendrán un impacto significativo en la labor de la Corte, en su dedicado personal y en sus familias (…) Seguimos unidos en nuestro apoyo a la CPI y comprometidos a entablar un diálogo constructivo e inclusivo con los Estados que no son Partes". PHILIPPE BOLOPION, DIRECTOR EJECUTIVO DE HUMAN RIGHTS WATCH: "El Gobierno de Trump ha dejado claro su objetivo de destruir la CPI para proteger a los funcionarios estadounidenses e israelíes de tener que enfrentarse a cargos ante el tribunal. La CPI se creó para garantizar que nadie, por muy poderoso que sea, esté por sobre la ley. Los Gobiernos que valoran los derechos humanos y la rendición de cuentas deberían condenar esta medida escandalosa y tomar medidas rápidas para proteger a la CPI, a su personal y a todos aquellos que cooperan con ella, empezando por la Unión Europea, que debería utilizar su legislación para mitigar el impacto de las sanciones en la región".

item.title: Panthers F Brad Marchand (lower-body injury) out 6 weeks
item.description: Florida Panthers forward Brad Marchand will miss six weeks due to a lower-leg injury, coach Paul Maurice said Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Florida Panthers forward Brad Marchand will miss six weeks due to a lower-leg injury, coach Paul Maurice said Friday. "Three weeks he will be back on the ice, another three to rehab," Maurice told reporters after practice. Marchand, 38, took a stick to the face late in the Panthers' 2-1 win over the host Los Angeles Kings on Tuesday. The hit caused him to twist and hit a goalpost with his right skate, which caused both legs to bend awkwardly. He grabbed his left knee as he lay face-down on the ice. Unable to put weight on the leg, he needed help from teammates to get off the ice and further assistance to get to the dressing room. Marchand missed the first two games of the season as he recovered from reported hip and sports hernia injuries. He has played in Florida's two games since, tallying one goal. The longtime Boston Bruin is a two-time Stanley Cup winner and has amassed 1,035 points (452 goals, 583 assists) over 1,154 NHL regular-season games since his debut in October 2009. The Panthers lost Marchand five days after forward Aleksander Barkov went down with a left leg injury that is expected to keep him out for six to eight weeks. "When they go down and you see that, you're worried," Maurice said. "We went through that last year." Marchand missed 30 games last season, including the final 19 after a win over the Detroit Red Wings on March 6 because of a lower-body injury. Barkov sustained his injury during the second period of Florida's 4-3 overtime loss to the San Jose Sharks on Oct. 1. It was his second game back after missing the entire 2025-26 season due to torn ligaments in his right knee. --Field Level Media

item.title: Moroccan king says migration cooperation model with Spain hit limit
item.description: King Mohammed VI said on Friday that Morocco's efforts to curb irregular migration had produced "concrete results," but that the current cooperation model with Spain had reached its limits amid recurring crises.
item.dc:creator: Ahmed Eljechtimi
item.content:encoded: King Mohammed VI said on Friday that Morocco's efforts to curb irregular migration had produced "concrete results," but that the current cooperation model with Spain had reached its limits amid recurring crises. At least 70,000 people [USN:S8N3VJ0CQ TEXT:"crossed"] from Morocco into the enclave of Ceuta in July. Most have returned but thousands, including minors, [USN:L8N45Q015 TEXT:"remained"]. Speaking at the parliament's opening, the king cited "obsolete" and "unrealistic" Spanish court decisions that hindered cooperation on migration. "They are regrettably impeding the repatriation of minors and of fake asylum seekers, while fueling the greed of criminal networks," he said. Since the Ceuta migration crisis, [USN:L1N45A0G3 TEXT:"Spanish opposition"] parties have blamed Pedro Sanchez's government and [USN:L1N4520W0 TEXT:"accused"] Rabat of facilitating the crossing. Morocco rejected the accusations, blaming the crossing on social media and misinterpretations of a court ruling that appeared to open a legal loophole for arrivals by sea. Morocco's partnership with Spain was a "sovereign choice" and "it will never be subject to any pressure, threat, or blackmail," the king said. He added that Morocco would propose a vision centred on shared development, economic competitiveness and regional stability to its partners. Relations between Morocco and Spain have improved since Spain backed Morocco's autonomy plan for Western Sahara in 2022. But bilateral ties have faced a [USN:L1N45N08Q TEXT:"test"] since the Ceuta migration crisis. The king [USN:S8N3SV012 TEXT:"appointed"] Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as the country's first female prime minister, after her party finished on top in the September 23 election. He urged members of parliament to put young people at the heart of public policies.

item.title: Fed diz que renda, patrimônio e estresse financeiro das famílias aumentaram de 2022 a 2025 nos EUA
item.description: A saída da pandemia da Covid-19 aumentou a renda e a riqueza da maioria das famílias americanas, com os ganhos de renda concentrados entre as camadas menos favorecidas, mas com mais riqueza fluindo para os 10% mais ricos, segundo mostrou uma nova pesquisa do Federal Reserve que abrange o período de 2022 a 2025.
item.dc:creator: Howard Schneider
item.content:encoded: A saída da pandemia da Covid-19 aumentou a renda e a riqueza da maioria das famílias americanas, com os ganhos de renda concentrados entre as camadas menos favorecidas, mas com mais riqueza fluindo para os 10% mais ricos, segundo mostrou uma nova pesquisa do Federal Reserve que abrange o período de 2022 a 2025. A mais recente Pesquisa sobre Finanças do Consumidor do Fed, realizada a cada três anos e que abrange uma amostra representativa de cerca de 4.300 famílias em todo o país, mostra ganhos de riqueza muito mais lentos do que os observados durante os anos voláteis da pandemia, quando os mercados de ações despencaram e depois dispararam, e as famílias receberam trilhões de dólares em pagamentos de auxílio federal. A pesquisa foi realizada principalmente entre abril e maio do ano passado. Com a moderação no aumento da riqueza, segundo o Fed, o estresse financeiro aumentou para alguns. Em uma era “de expansão econômica moderada e inflação elevada... enquanto a maioria das famílias experimentou aumentos moderados na renda e no patrimônio líquido, um subconjunto crescente de famílias parece ter enfrentado estresse financeiro”, afirmou o Fed. Embora os ganhos de renda tenham sido maiores para as famílias menos abastadas, eles pouco contribuíram para aumentar sua riqueza, com o quarto inferior das famílias vendo seu patrimônio líquido cair mais de 50%, passando de US$3.800 na última pesquisa, em 2022, para US$1.700. A riqueza mediana das famílias negras, que cresceu 60% no período de 2019 a 2022, registrou “uma grande queda” de 25%, afirmou o Fed, que concluiu que os novos dados “reforçaram os padrões existentes de desigualdade de riqueza de acordo com as características familiares”, com famílias que já eram ricas, mais velhas, com maior escolaridade ou renda mais alta obtendo ganhos maiores do que as demais. Os ganhos de riqueza foram particularmente pronunciados, com alta de 37%, em famílias cujo membro principal tinha mais de 75 anos — um desequilíbrio geracional que se manifestou na formação mais lenta de famílias e na compra de imóveis entre as famílias mais jovens. Embora a dívida das famílias tenha permanecido estável e a alavancagem das famílias — a relação entre dívida e ativos — tenha diminuído, sinais de pressão da dívida vinham se acumulando em um período de alta inflação e aumento das taxas de juros. A mediana do pagamento da dívida como porcentagem da renda subiu 2 pontos percentuais, para 15,4%, e a relação total entre dívida e renda saltou de 89,4% em 2022 para 94,9%. Uma parcela maior de famílias, 8,6% contra 6,5%, tinha pagamentos de dívidas que consumiam mais de 40% de sua renda, o maior índice desde a pesquisa de 2013. ATRASOS EM PAGAMENTOS DE EMPRÉSTIMOS A pesquisa abrangeu anos em que os EUA estavam superando a volatilidade econômica da pandemia e caminhando para um “novo normal”, caracterizado por aumentos salariais mais modestos, acompanhados por um grande aumento na riqueza do mercado de ações. Alguns economistas descreveram o que está surgindo como uma distribuição em “forma de K”, com as famílias na base da pirâmide se mantendo à tona ou ficando para trás, enquanto aquelas com ativos ou renda mais alta estão avançando. “A proporção de famílias que relataram atrasos nos pagamentos de empréstimos aumentou acentuadamente de cerca de 12% para quase 20%”, informou o Fed. A renda familiar mediana geral, ajustada pela inflação, subiu 7%, para US$82.200, durante o período de três anos, quando o mercado de trabalho restrito da pandemia gradualmente deu lugar a um pequeno aumento no desemprego. O aumento maior da renda na extremidade inferior da distribuição de renda — variando de 4% a 7% para os 60% das famílias com menor renda, em comparação com uma queda de 6% na renda real dos 10% com maior renda — foi consistente com as condições da era pós-pandêmica, quando as empresas enfrentavam escassez de mão de obra, particularmente no setor de serviços, e os empregadores ofereciam aumentos salariais e bônus para atrair funcionários para as áreas de saúde, restaurantes e outras ocupações que exigiam atendimento presencial. O patrimônio líquido mediano real aumentou 2%, para US$ 215.900, e “a maioria das famílias, em todas as faixas de patrimônio líquido e renda, registrou aumentos”, afirmou o Fed em um comunicado à imprensa que acompanhou a pesquisa. A taxa de proprietários de imóveis permaneceu estável em cerca de 66%, enquanto a participação no mercado de ações caiu ligeiramente de 58% em 2022 para 56% em 2025.

item.title: Unipol gets ECB, Bank of Italy nod for de facto control of BPER Banca
item.description: Italian insurer Unipol said on Friday the European Central Bank and the Bank of Italy had granted it authorisations to exceed 20% of BPER Banca and thereby acquire de facto control of Italy's fifth-largest bank.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Italian insurer Unipol (UNPI.MI) said on Friday the European Central Bank and the Bank of Italy had granted it authorisations to exceed 20% of BPER Banca (EMII.MI) and thereby acquire de facto control of Italy's fifth-largest bank. Unipol aims to hold more than 30% of a future banking group combining BPER Banca and assets carved out of Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) (BMPS.MI) , with scope to increase that stake over time, its chief executive said in August.

item.title: Fuerte sismo remece Panamá, se siente hasta Costa Rica
item.description: Un fuerte sismo de magnitud 7.6 remeció el viernes Panamá y se sintió hasta la vecina Costa Rica, dijeron testigos de Reuters y autoridades.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un fuerte sismo de magnitud 7.6 remeció el viernes Panamá y se sintió hasta la vecina Costa Rica, dijeron testigos de Reuters y autoridades. El epicentro del movimiento telúrico se ubicó 10 kilómetros al oeste-suroeste de la pequeña localidad Pitaloza Arriba, ubicada al sur del país, y a una profundidad de 10 kilómetros, según datos del Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos (USGS, por su sigla en inglés). Tras el sismo, el Centro de Alerta de Tsunamis del Pacífico (PTWC, por su sigla en inglés), emitió una alerta de posibles "olas peligrosas" a lo largo de las costas de Costa Rica, Ecuador, Perú, Nicaragua, Guatemala, El Salvador y México. Imágenes en redes sociales y medios locales mostraron algunos daños materiales como techos caídos en universidades y gente siendo evacuada de enormes edificios. El Canal de Panamá, por donde atraviesa alrededor del 3% del comercio marítimo mundial, dijo que, preliminarmente, seguía operando normalmente.

item.description: Um forte terremoto de magnitude 7,6 ocorreu perto da costa sul do Panamá nesta sexta-feira, a uma profundidade de 10 km, de acordo com o Serviço Geológico dos EUA, mas inicialmente não foram relatados danos, e a Autoridade do Canal do Panamá informou que a hidrovia estava operando normalmente.
