item.content:encoded: Um forte terremoto de magnitude 7,6 ocorreu perto da costa sul do Panamá nesta sexta-feira, a uma profundidade de 10 km, de acordo com o Serviço Geológico dos EUA, mas inicialmente não foram relatados danos, e a Autoridade do Canal do Panamá informou que a hidrovia estava operando normalmente. Imagens da televisão panamenha mostraram pessoas deixando prédios. O epicentro do terremoto ficou próximo à comunidade rural de La Pitaloza, em uma área pouco povoada no sul do país, próxima à costa do Pacífico. O impacto levou o Sistema de Alerta de Tsunamis dos EUA a alertar que ondas de tsunami perigosas poderiam ocorrer ao longo de trechos das costas do Panamá, Colômbia, Costa Rica, Equador, Peru, Nicarágua, Guatemala, El Salvador e México nas próximas três horas. O sistema também informou que havia ameaça de tsunami no Havaí. O terremoto foi sentido na capital, Cidade do Panamá, bem como na capital da vizinha Costa Rica, segundo testemunhas da Reuters. (Reportagem de Elida Moreno na Cidade do Panamá e de Iñigo Alexander na Cidade do México; reportagem adicional de Álvaro Murillo em San José)

item.title: US Gulf producers shut in more oil and gas as Isaias nears landfall
item.description: US producers in the Gulf of Mexico shut in about 1.5 million barrels per day of oil production and 1.3 billion cubic feet per day of natural gas, an increase from Thursday, as Hurricane Isaias churned toward the coast ahead of an expected landfall along the Florida Panhandle late on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US producers in the Gulf of Mexico shut in about 1.5 million barrels per day of oil production and 1.3 billion cubic feet per day of natural gas, an increase from Thursday, as Hurricane Isaias churned toward the coast ahead of an expected landfall along the Florida Panhandle late on Friday. The shut-ins represent nearly 72% and 59% of US oil and natural gas production in the Gulf, respectively, according to the Marine Minerals Administration. Personnel have been evacuated from 129 production platforms, representing 35% of the 371 staffed platforms in the Gulf of Mexico, the agency said. It added that crews had also been evacuated from eight non-dynamically positioned rigs. The US federal offshore Gulf of Mexico produces about 2 million barrels of oil a day, according to the US Energy Information Administration, or roughly 15% of total US crude output. The region also produces an average of about 2.1 billion cubic feet per day of natural gas. Isaias, the first hurricane of the 2026 Atlantic season, has strengthened into a [USN:FWN45V0NH TEXT:"Category"] 3 hurricane and is moving north-northeast. Weakening is expected after the storm makes landfall, according to the National Hurricane Center. The hurricane could disrupt roughly 7.2 million barrels of Gulf oil production, according to Earth Science Associates. The consulting firm cut its forecast from 9 million barrels on Thursday as the storm's projected path tracked eastward. The companies with the most exposure to the storm include BP (BP.L) , Chevron (CVX.N) , ENI (ENI.MI) , Murphy Oil (MUR.N) and Shell (SHEL.L) , among others, according to the Earth Science model. Shell [USN:FWN45U20T TEXT:"said"] late on Thursday it had completed evacuations at its Appomattox, Mars, Ursa, Olympus and Vito facilities, while production remained shut in at Mars, Ursa, Olympus and Vito. Chevron has evacuated most personnel from its Gulf of Mexico facilities, while maintaining production at four operated platforms and shutting in output at the remaining five. "At our onshore facilities, we continue to follow our established storm preparedness procedures and are closely monitoring the projected path of the hurricane," the company said in a statement on Friday. About 500,000 barrels of daily refining capacity are in the storm’s path, including the Pascagoula, Mississippi, refinery, Energy Aspects estimated.

item.title: Katie Zacharia picked as White House press secretary
item.description: Katie Zacharia, a communications adviser for President Donald Trump's Truth Social platform, has been offered the position of White House press secretary following Karoline Leavitt's departure from the role in August, a White House official said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Jasper Ward
item.content:encoded: Katie Zacharia, a communications adviser for President Donald Trump 's Truth Social platform, has been offered the position of White House press secretary following Karoline Leavitt's [USN:FWN4491F6 TEXT:"departure"] from the role in August, a White House official said on Friday. Zacharia did not immediately respond to a request for comment. If she accepts the role, she would fill a critical position in the Trump administration before next month's midterm congressional elections . The New York Times first reported the news. The selection would put Zacharia at the center of the White House's public messaging operation in the final stretch before the elections, when Trump's agenda and his party's control of Congress will be put before voters. Trump's approval rating fell to 32% — the lowest of his political career — as his fellow Republicans soured on his handling of the cost of living and the Iran war , a recent [USN:L6N45D0NV TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos"] poll found. The selection of Zacharia underscores the close ties between Trump's administration and his broader political and media operation. It comes after Trump Media unveiled in July that for a fee it would give banks and trading firms "the fastest" [USN:L4N43I1AE TEXT:"access to posts"] from influential Truth Social accounts, such as the president's, whose posts often move global markets. Zacharia has worked as a senior communications adviser for Truth Social, the Republican president's social media platform, and the Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT.O) since June, according to her LinkedIn page. She briefly served as a spokesperson for the Department of Homeland Security before departing in March. Zacharia, an attorney who frequently appears on conservative outlets Fox News and Newsmax, previously worked as a legal adviser for Fix California, a conservative group that aims to address what it described as "the left's stranglehold" on state politics. The group was founded by Richard Grenell, who has served as Trump's envoy to Venezuela and the interim president and executive director of the Kennedy Center in Washington. Zacharia interned at the White House during President George W. Bush's administration.

item.title: Powerful quake hits Panama, damages homes; canal operations normal
item.description: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck near the southern coast of Panama on Friday at a 12.6-km (7.8 miles) depth, according to the US Geological Survey, damaging some buildings but without affecting the critical Panama Canal trade waterway.
item.dc:creator: Elida Moreno
item.content:encoded: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck near the southern coast of Panama on Friday at a 12.6-km (7.8 miles) depth, according to the US Geological Survey, damaging some buildings but without affecting the critical Panama Canal trade waterway. In Panama, where earthquakes of this magnitude are rare, television images showed elderly residents reduced to tears in the streets as a series of weaker aftershocks rattled the country. “We’re scared. It’s just the two of us old folks here. The house has cracked, and we’re afraid it could fall on us,” said Ricardo Brown, 74, speaking by phone from the Las Minas area in Herrera province in southern Panama, where he noted the quake damaged a number of homes. The quake's epicenter was close to the rural community of La Pitaloza in a sparsely populated area of Herrera, near the Pacific coastline. Shaking was also felt as far as San Jose, the capital of neighboring Costa Rica, according to a Reuters witness. Omar Smith, who heads Panama's civil protection agency, told local outlet Telemetro Reporta that impacts had been reported in Chitre, the capital of Herrera, and along the coast in Los Santos province. Videos shared by newspaper La Prensa showed the tower of a historic building had collapsed along with several balconies of a residential building in Penonome, a city about halfway between the epicenter and Panama City. In the capital, the service on two lines of the Panama City Metro was temporarily suspended for safety reasons, the operator said. Nationwide, Panama's ministry of education ordered the closure of schools. The impact prompted the US Tsunami Warning System to warn that hazardous tsunami waves were possible along parts of the coasts of Panama, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Peru, Nicaragua, Guatemala, El Salvador and Mexico within the next three hours. The system also said there was a tsunami threat to Hawaii, while Chile's navy also issued a tsunami alert. Panama was due to hold a national evacuation drill on Monday of next week to test the country's emergency response capabilities against earthquakes.

item.title: US judge rules Justice Department use of voter rolls unlawful
item.description: A US judge ruled on Friday that the Justice Department’s push to obtain state voter rolls and check them against a federal immigration database in order to demand that states remove voters it deemed ineligible was unlawful.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen
item.content:encoded: A US judge ruled on Friday that the Justice Department’s push to obtain [USN:L6N41312P TEXT:"state voter rolls"] and check them against a federal immigration database in order to demand that states remove voters it deemed ineligible was unlawful. US District Judge Sparkle Sooknanan's decision marked the latest setback for President Donald Trump 's push to expand federal control over election administration ahead of the November 3 midterms , with his Republican Party battling to hold majorities in both houses of Congress. In a 78-page decision siding with a challenge to the Justice Department's practice brought by watchdog group Common Cause, Sooknanan wrote that the Justice Department had downplayed the risk that its practice would wrongfully disenfranchise eligible US citizens despite evidence that the immigration database, known as SAVE, could be inaccurate. "The challenged policy represents the federal government's attempt to decide who gets to vote. But Congress has left that authority where our Constitution has always placed it: with the states," wrote Sooknanan, who is based in Washington and was appointed by Democratic President Joe Biden. The Justice Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In a separate case, Sooknanan in June blocked the Trump administration from using an expanded version of the SAVE database to check the accuracy of voter rolls. The US Supreme Court last month temporarily paused that decision. Federal election law prohibits the systematic review of voter rolls in the 90 days before any federal election, potentially blunting the impact of both Sooknanan's decision as well as the Supreme Court's pause of her previous order on the upcoming midterms.

item.title: Papa Leão aprova filipino Tagle como primeiro decano asiático do colégio de cardeais católicos
item.description: O papa Leão aprovou a eleição do cardeal filipino Luis Tagle como decano do colégio de cardeais da Igreja Católica, informou o Vaticano nesta sexta-feira, na primeira vez que um clérigo asiático é escolhido para liderar esse grupo de elite que, um dia, elegerá o sucessor de Leão.
item.dc:creator: Joshua McElwee
item.content:encoded: O papa Leão aprovou a eleição do cardeal filipino Luis Tagle como decano do colégio de cardeais da Igreja Católica, informou o Vaticano nesta sexta-feira, na primeira vez que um clérigo asiático é escolhido para liderar esse grupo de elite que, um dia, elegerá o sucessor de Leão. Ex-arcebispo de Manila, Tagle atua como autoridade de alto escalão do Vaticano desde 2020. Ele era amplamente considerado um provável candidato ao papado no conclave de maio de 2025, que elegeu Leão para liderar a Igreja após a morte do papa Francisco. Tagle, de 69 anos, substitui o cardeal italiano Giovanni Battista Re, de 92 anos, que está se aposentando. Leão, de 71 anos, é relativamente jovem para um papa, pratica esportes e goza de boa saúde. O decano do colégio de cardeais é considerado o “primeiro entre iguais” entre os clérigos de mais alto escalão da Igreja e é responsável por conduzir o processo secreto do conclave, realizado na Capela Sistina, assim que um papa morre ou renuncia. O decano, eleito por seus pares e aprovado pelo papa, cumpre um mandato de cinco anos que pode ser renovado uma vez, de acordo com a lei da Igreja. O cargo tem sido ocupado principalmente por europeus, mas foi exercido pelo falecido cardeal beninense Bernardin Gantin de 1993 a 2002. Tagle era visto como um aliado próximo do papa Francisco e é conhecido por seu sorriso contagiante, sendo às vezes chamado pelo apelido carinhoso de “Chito”. Ele lidera o Dicastério para a Evangelização do Vaticano, que é, na prática, o braço missionário da Igreja.

item.title: Chefe de agência dos EUA remete ao Pentágono decisão sobre transmissão de fuzilamento na TV
item.description: O presidente da Comissão Federal de Comunicações dos Estados Unidos (FCC) afirmou nesta sexta-feira que deixará a cargo do Pentágono a decisão sobre se emissoras de TV norte-americanas poderão transmitir uma execução militar por fuzilamento prevista para 3 de dezembro.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: O presidente da Comissão Federal de Comunicações dos Estados Unidos (FCC) afirmou nesta sexta-feira que deixará a cargo do Pentágono a decisão sobre se emissoras de TV norte-americanas poderão transmitir uma execução militar por fuzilamento prevista para 3 de dezembro. O secretário de Defesa dos EUA, Pete Hegseth, disse na quinta-feira que a execução por fuzilamento de Nidal Hasan seria transmitida ao vivo. Hasan é um ex-psiquiatra do exército norte-americano que foi condenado por matar 13 pessoas e ferir outras 32 na base militar de Fort Hood, no estado do Texas, em 2009. Carr disse à CNBC que, pelo que entende, a transmissão não será feita pela TV aberta. Mas, quando questionado se permitiria que fosse transmitida, ele disse: “Em última instância, vamos deixar a decisão a cargo do secretário Hegseth, e vocês sabem quais são as decisões dele sobre como proceder com isso.” Um porta-voz da FCC não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. As emissoras ABC, NBC, CBS e Fox não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário sobre se estão considerando transmitir o fuzilamento. Andrew Jay Schwartzman, consultor sênior do Benton Institute for Broadband & Society e especialista em questões relacionadas à FCC, afirmou que não há base legal para que a comissão intervenha na decisão de uma emissora sobre a transmissão ao vivo de uma execução. “Não há absolutamente nenhuma justificativa na Lei das Comunicações ou na Constituição que permita à FCC determinar às emissoras que transmitam ou não um evento real”, disse ele, acrescentando: “não há base para a FCC ditar conteúdo ou proibir conteúdo, a menos que se trate de obscenidade.” Um relatório de 2007 da FCC sobre violência na televisão afirmou que a agência não tinha autoridade para regulamentar conteúdo violento. O relatório indicou que “discursos violentos e representações de violência foram considerados pelos tribunais como protegidos pela Primeira Emenda”. O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, ordenou nesta semana que Hasan seja executado por pelotão de fuzilamento. A morte por fuzilamento é uma das várias formas de pena capital que o governo Trump recentemente incluiu entre as maneiras permitidas de execução para os crimes federais mais graves, juntamente com a eletrocussão e a asfixia por gás. Hasan deve se tornar a primeira pessoa a ser executada por um pelotão de fuzilamento das Forças Armadas dos EUA desde 1945. A execução está marcada para 3 de dezembro na mesma base no Texas onde Hasan abriu fogo. A Organização das Nações Unidas classificou nesta sexta-feira como “repugnante” plano dos EUA de transmitir ao vivo a execução e afirmou que isso pode constituir uma violação das proibições contra a tortura.

item.title: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels to start vs. Giants
item.description: Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels, who missed the last two games because of a dislocated left elbow, will start against the visiting New York Giants on Sunday, Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels, who missed the last two games because of a dislocated left elbow, will start against the visiting New York Giants on Sunday, Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Friday. Quinn also said that wide receiver Stefon Diggs has been ruled out because of a hamstring injury and receiver Terry McLaurin's status is to be determined after he looked good in his return to practice Friday from a hamstring injury. Daniels, 25, hurt his non-throwing elbow on the last play of the first half in a loss to the host Dallas Cowboys in Week 2. He traveled with the Commanders (1-3) to London last week for their 30-13 loss to the Indianapolis Colts but did not suit up. Veteran Marcus Mariota started against the Colts but suffered a knee injury. Rookie Athan Kaliakmanis replaced him, throwing for 186 yards, one touchdown and one interception. Daniels has been practicing with a brace, and he will keep it on against the Giants (3-1). "I'm gonna embrace the brace," Daniels said Wednesday. "Go out there and be the best version of myself." The 2024 Offensive Rookie of the Year has thrown for 260 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions this season while completing 56.9 percent of his passes. He also has rushed 12 times for 100 yards. He is 3-0 in his career against the Giants. Daniels played in seven games last season (all starts) while suffering multiple injuries. The team went 2-5 in those games. He passed for 1,262 yards, eight touchdowns and three interceptions. For his career, Daniels has completed 474 of 719 passes (65.9 percent) for 5,090 yards, 36 TDs and 12 picks in 26 regular-season games (all starts). He also has rushed 218 times for 1,269 yards and eight TDs. In three playoff games, he has passed for 822 yards, five scores and one pick, and rushed for 135 yards and one TD. Washington selected Daniels second overall in the 2024 NFL Draft out of LSU. Diggs, 32, has 18 receptions for 170 yards and three touchdowns -- all team highs -- in four games (two starts). The four-time Pro Bowl selection and 2020 first-team All-Pro signed with Washington as a free agent on Aug. 5. McLaurin, 31, has 10 catches for 141 yards and one TD in three games. The two-time Pro Bowl pick missed the loss to Indianapolis because of the hamstring injury he suffered in practice that week. Quinn also said that starting right guard Sam Cosmi, who has missed two games because of a concussion, and running back Rachaad White (shoulder) will play. --Field Level Media

item.title: Supervisores de mina chilena Escondida de BHP no ven avance en mediación para evitar huelga: líder
item.description: Los supervisores de la chilena Escondida, el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre y controlado por BHP, no ven avances en un proceso de mediación gubernamental con la empresa que busca evitar una huelga, dijo el viernes a Reuters el presidente del gremio, Alexis Barrera.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los supervisores de la chilena Escondida, el mayor yacimiento mundial de cobre y controlado por BHP, no ven avances en un proceso de mediación gubernamental con la empresa que busca evitar una huelga, dijo el viernes a Reuters el presidente del gremio, Alexis Barrera. Los agremiados [USN:L6N45M19L TEXT:"rechazaron a fines de septiembre"] por amplia mayoría una oferta de contrato colectivo presentada por la empresa, lo que llevó a un proceso de mediación que cumplió el viernes su cuarta jornada. "La empresa, a pesar de haber solicitado ella esta mediación obligatoria para frenar la huelga que teníamos programada, hasta el día de hoy, hasta el cuarto día no ha sido capaz de presentar una oferta nueva", aseguró Barrera. "Nosotros ayer entregamos una propuesta nueva. Después de la última oferta, una nueva propuesta con el compromiso que la empresa debía entregar una respuesta a esta propuesta, pero llegó y no presentó nada", detalló. El dirigente dijo que seguían disponibles a continuar el diálogo siempre y cuando exista una propuesta "con avances significativos, concretos e importantes". Dos puntos relevantes que el sindicato citó contra la oferta era la intención de la compañía de que los socios se adiestraran para realizar operaciones de planta -como manejo de camiones y trabajos de faena-, así como adoptar turnos 14-14 (días de trabajo/descanso) en caso de contingencias. Dos fuentes con conocimiento de la negociación dijeron a Reuters que la empresa accedió a dejar fuera de la discusión ambos puntos para allanar un acuerdo. El temor de un huelga en Escondida y [USN:L6N45V0VK TEXT:"la paralización en curso de la mina Centinela"] de Antofagasta Minerals han dado soporte a los precios globales del cobre en momentos en que la industria atraviesa dificultades para impulsar la oferta.

item.title: Bears RB Kyle Monangai (toe) out vs. Packers
item.description: Chicago Bears running back Kyle Monangai has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the host Green Bay Packers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chicago Bears running back Kyle Monangai has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the host Green Bay Packers. Monangai, who was spotted in a walking boot, is dealing with turf toe. He has not participated in practice this week after recording 30 carries for 146 yards and two touchdowns in Chicago's 23-12 victory over the New York Jets last Sunday. D'Andre Swift is expected to receive the majority of the carries for the Bears (3-1) against the Packers (2-2). He was a limited participant in practice Thursday, one day after sitting out Wednesday's session due to hip and knee injuries. Swift ceded carries to Monangai last Sunday after losing a fumble. He rushed 15 times for 58 yards versus the Jets but has two fumbles since Week 2. "I know that's not me," Swift said, per The Athletic. "That's not a part of my game. It hasn't been. So I'm not about to make it one. That's over with now." Monangai leads the team with 324 rushing yards and is tied for the team lead with three rushing touchdowns. Swift has 311 yards and three TDs on the ground. --Field Level Media

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Flávio não citou fim do 13º ao falar de reformas
item.description: O coordenador da campanha do candidato à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), senador Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), não disse em entrevista que o presidenciável pretende aumentar a idade mínima de aposentadoria para 75 anos e cortar direitos trabalhistas, como 13º salário e férias remuneradas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: O coordenador da campanha do candidato à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), senador Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), não disse em entrevista que o presidenciável pretende aumentar a idade mínima de aposentadoria para 75 anos e cortar direitos trabalhistas, como 13º salário e férias remuneradas. Postagens no Threads espalham uma imagem com a alegação de que Marinho disse ao jornal Folha de S. Paulo que um eventual governo Flávio Bolsonaro fará novas reformas na Previdência e em direitos trabalhistas. As publicações listam uma série de supostas previsões do senador para essas reformas, incluindo "aumentar a idade mínima para 75 anos para homens, com 50 anos de contribuição", "fim do BPC/Loas", "fim dos 13º salários", "fim do seguro-desemprego", entre outros direitos e benefícios. A entrevista com Marinho publicada pela Folha em março diz que o senador falou em "revisitar" as reformas da Previdência e trabalhista, sem dar detalhes. "O modelo está estourando. Só posso dizer que a gente vai ter que revisitar a Previdência. A trabalhista tem que ser revisitada, porque a reforma de 2017 foi mitigada por várias decisões judiciais. Ao mesmo tempo, ela precisa ser atualizada pelas inovações tecnológicas, pelas novas formas de trabalho que estão crescendo", disse o senador ao jornal. A Reuters também não encontrou na imprensa declarações públicas de Marinho propondo o aumento da idade mínima de aposentadoria ou o fim dos direitos e benefícios citados. O plano de governo de Flávio enviado ao Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) diz que, se eleito, o candidato pretende fazer "uma ampla revisão normativa infralegal" nas áreas previdenciária e trabalhista. O documento não menciona qualquer previsão de idade mínima ou cortes de benefícios. A campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário, mas o site da campanha diz que o plano de governo do candidato afirma expressamente que os programas sociais existentes serão mantidos. Sobre questões trabalhistas, o site afirma que Flávio defende "a remuneração por hora trabalhada, com a manutenção de todos os direitos trabalhistas conquistados, como FGTS, férias e 13º salário". A assessoria de imprensa do senador Rogério Marinho enviou nota dizendo que o plano de governo de Flávio prevê a manutenção dos programas sociais existentes e que o BPC está garantido na Constituição. "Décimo terceiro, férias remuneradas, abono do PIS e jornada de oito horas estão na Constituição, e o plano defende jornada flexível dentro da lei, combinada entre trabalhador e empresa", diz a nota. VEREDICTO Falso. O coordenador da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, Rogério Marinho, disse à Folha que o candidato pode "revisitar" reformas da Previdência e trabalhistas, mas não falou em aumentar a idade de aposentadoria ou em extinguir direitos trabalhistas e benefícios sociais. item.title: French police arrest three 17-year-olds suspected of running stolen data websites
item.description: France's anti-cybercrime unit has closed two websites alleged to be selling stolen data and arrested three 17-year-olds suspected of running them, Paris prosecutor Laure Beccuau said in a statement on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: France's anti-cybercrime unit has closed two websites alleged to be selling stolen data and arrested three 17-year-olds suspected of running them, Paris prosecutor Laure Beccuau said in a statement on Friday. The Reacher platform was created in March and offered stolen personal data from different sources to the public through different kinds of subscriptions, the statement said The service, which was renamed Stryx in June, claimed to store 730 million lines of data, including names, addresses and bank account numbers, and had received 3.1 million requests The three male teenagers could face up to 10 years in prison, if convicted

item.title: South Africa's Coetze breaks men's 50m backstroke short-course world record
item.description: South Africa's Pieter Coetze set a 50m backstroke short-course world record on Friday with a time of 22.09 seconds at a World Aquatics World Cup meet in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Africa's Pieter Coetze set a 50m backstroke short-course world record on Friday with a time of 22.09 seconds at a World Aquatics World Cup meet in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. The previous record of 22.11 was set by Russia's Kliment Kolesnikov in Kazan in 2022. Kolesnikov also holds the long-course record of 23.55. The record was a career first for 100m backstroke world champion Coetze, 22, after coming close to breaking the 100m world record at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow last July. "Seeing that time on the board, it didn’t even click that it was a world record,” said the South African. “And then, like, a second later, I was like…’the world record was 22.1.’ So…not many words to describe that. It’s crazy." Kolesnikov was also in Friday's race but finished sixth in 22.88, with compatriot Egor Kornev -- who tied Australian Kyle Chalmers' 2021 100m freestyle shortcourse world record of 44.84 in Baku last week -- second in 22.29 after mis-timing his finish. "I don’t think it changes much,” Coetze said of his record. “My mindset normally stays the same, no matter what the race is, because at this level everyone is always close. The world-record holder was there, and look how close it was. So, no, you can never get too comfortable." The 50m backstroke will be making its Olympic debut at the 2028 Los Angeles Games. Kornev again won the 100m freestyle final, this time hitting the wall in the same time of 45.24 as Australian Cameron McEvoy despite a back injury. “I think he’s going to go insanely fast in two months’ time,” said McEvoy of his rival. “This is just a warm-up for Egor. So I’m happy I can fight with him and be a good foe right now, but I believe that, in two months’ time, he’s going to drop something pretty special." The short-course world championships are in Beijing from December 1-6.

item.title: Foto de Virginia Fonseca fazendo o “L” é montagem
item.description: Publicações nas redes sociais exibem uma foto da influenciadora digital Virginia Fonseca fazendo o “L”, gesto adotado pela campanha à reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, mas o registro é uma montagem.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Publicações nas redes sociais exibem uma foto da influenciadora digital Virginia Fonseca fazendo o “L”, gesto adotado pela campanha à reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, mas o registro é uma montagem. Estes são os principais detalhes: “Gente, e a Virginia que declarou apoio ao Lula?”, diz uma das postagens , no Facebook. A influenciadora compartilhou a fotografia original em março deste ano, quando sites de notícias também divulgaram a imagem . “Virginia Fonseca, 26, foi diagnosticada com uma virose e usou o Instagram Stories, na tarde de hoje, para relatar como está”, escreveu o BOL no dia 12 daquele mês. Na foto para os Stories, a influenciadora inseriu “Quero que vocês adivinhem quem pegou virose da Maria Alice (filha dela)” e faz um sinal de “eu” com o dedo indicador. Segundo o detector de conteúdo produzido por IA da OpenAI, a imagem checada foi gerada por ferramentas da empresa. À Reuters, a assessoria de Virginia disse que a foto dela fazendo o “L” é falsa. Até o momento, a influenciadora não declarou apoio a nenhum candidato nas eleições, cujo segundo turno está marcado para o próximo dia 25. Veredicto: Alterado digitalmente. É montagem a foto de Virginia Fonseca fazendo o “L” em apoio ao presidente Lula. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. item.title: Presidente de EEUU presiona a México por acuerdos energéticos en conversaciones comerciales: FT
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, insistió durante una llamada con la presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, en que haya más acuerdos y alianzas entre empresas energéticas mexicanas y estadounidenses, informó el Financial Times el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, insistió durante una llamada con la presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, en que haya más acuerdos y alianzas entre empresas energéticas mexicanas y estadounidenses, informó el Financial Times el viernes. Los mandatarios también hablaron de un acuerdo parecido al que se firmó el año pasado con Corea del Sur. En ese convenio, Seúl se comprometió a comprar 100,000 millones de dólares en productos energéticos estadounidenses y a invertir miles de millones más en Estados Unidos, dijo FT, citando a personas al tanto del asunto. Un funcionario estadounidense dijo al FT que los mandatarios hablaron sobre la posibilidad de que México compre más gas natural estadounidense. México ya depende de ese gas para cubrir cerca de tres cuartas partes de su demanda. Según el funcionario, las conversaciones se centraron en reducir el superávit comercial de México con Estados Unidos.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro não disse em vídeo que ficará “décadas no poder”
item.description: Publicações nas redes sociais exibem um vídeo e atribuem ao candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) a frase “a gente vai ficar por décadas no poder”, mas o senador não fez esta afirmação na filmagem.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Publicações nas redes sociais exibem um vídeo e atribuem ao candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) a frase “a gente vai ficar por décadas no poder”, mas o senador não fez esta afirmação na filmagem. Estes são os principais detalhes: Postagens no Instagram e no Threads compartilham a gravação com o texto “‘Vai ser o fim da Era Lula e a gente vai ficar por décadas no poder’, diz Flávio em reunião com aliados”. As imagens foram publicadas originalmente pelo site de notícias Correio Braziliense, mas com a informação correta. O portal descreveu que, durante um evento com apoiadores em Brasília na última quarta-feira, Flávio afirmou que o Brasil está "cansado" do atual presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva e que, caso vença o segundo turno , o país ficará "por décadas sem falar de PT". O áudio do vídeo também confirma a fala do senador. “A gente vai ganhar, se Deus quiser, em nome de Jesus, daqui a poucos dias. É sinal de que o Brasil deu a resposta, isso é democracia. E, para desespero deles, vai ser o fim da era Lula, e a gente vai ficar por décadas sem falar de PT aqui”, falou. No mesmo dia, o senador disse que pretende acabar com a possibilidade de presidentes do Brasil se reelegerem. Veredicto: Legenda errada. Flávio Bolsonaro não disse em um vídeo que ficará “décadas no poder”. O candidato afirmou que o Brasil ficará “por décadas sem falar de PT". item.title: Hope century powers West Indies past India to level T20 series
item.description: Shai Hope struck a century as West Indies completed their highest successful chase in T20 internationals, overhauling a target of 250 to beat India by six wickets on Friday in Ranchi and level the five-match series at 1-1.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shai Hope struck a century as West Indies completed their highest successful chase in T20 internationals, overhauling a target of 250 to beat India by six wickets on Friday in Ranchi and level the five-match series at 1-1. Chasing a daunting target, West Indies were rocked early when paceman Mayank Yadav removed Kamil Pooran and Shimron Hetmyer with successive deliveries in the opening over and later dismissed Rovman Powell for 24. "But when you chase here in India, you always give yourself a chance. You always think you're in the game, regardless of what score is on the board," Hope said. "But five for two was always going to be challenging." Skipper Hope and Sherfane Rutherford turned the match on its head with a blistering 120-run partnership for the fourth wicket. Rutherford survived on 38 when Yadav spilled a straightforward chance at short fine leg and capitalised on the reprieve, hammering 84 off 37 balls before falling to Kuldeep Yadav. Hope remained unfazed, anchoring the chase while maintaining the required rate, and combined with Romario Shepherd to guide West Indies home with nine balls to spare. Hope remained unbeaten on 102 from 45 deliveries. "When we got that partnership there, we just got some more impetus in the innings," Hope said. "Then obviously Sherfane came and did what he did, played really well with the bat, and just gave us that spark that we needed to get over the line today." This is the second-highest successful run chase in men's T20 international history, surpassed only by South Africa's pursuit of 259 against West Indies in 2023. Earlier, Samson's 41-ball 82 underpinned India's total after he and Abhishek Sharma raced to 42 in less than four overs for the opening wicket. Chase halted the early surge by dismissing Sharma and later removed Kishan for 43 and Shivam Dube, while Shamar Springer struck with the key wicket of Samson. India accelerated again at the death through Iyer and Tilak Varma, who put on 83 runs from 32 balls, with Iyer making 40 before falling off the penultimate delivery as the hosts finished on 249-5. The teams meet again in the third T20 in Indore on Sunday.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro descarta privatização da Petrobras como "boataria"
item.description: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato do PL à Presidência, negou nesta sexta-feira rumores de que, se for eleito, tentará privatizar a Petrobras e outras empresas estatais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato do PL à Presidência, negou nesta sexta-feira rumores de que, se for eleito, tentará privatizar a Petrobras (PETR3.SA) e outras empresas estatais. Segundo ele, existe uma onda de boatos contra a sua candidatura para tentar reverter a liderança que teve no primeiro turno da eleição presidencial. “Isso é uma boataria, é uma boataria atrás da outra”, disse Flávio a jornalistas na entrada de um encontro com apoiadores e empresários na zona sudoeste do Rio de Janeiro. Flávio Bolsonaro venceu o primeiro turno da eleição presidencial com 47,03% dos votos válidos, contra 45,16% do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que tenta a reeleição. As primeiras pesquisas após a votação de domingo mostram que o senador continua à frente do petista antes do segundo turno, marcado para o dia 25 deste mês. Ao ser questionado se pretendia mudar o comando da estatal, caso seja eleito, o candidato do PL disse que primeiro é preciso mudar o presidente da República. Durante o governo de seu pai, Jair Bolsonaro, vários ativos e bens da empresa, como refinarias, foram vendidos, num movimento visto por alguns como uma tentativa de esvaziar e enfraquecer a companhia para viabilizar uma futura venda. Flávio Bolsonaro acusou ainda o atual governo de estar preparando uma bomba para os consumidores brasileiros com programas de subsídio, subvenção e desoneração de combustíveis. Nesta sexta-feira, o [USN:L1N45V0MB TEXT:"governo anunciou"] a ampliação dessas medidas para diesel, gasolina e etanol por 30 dias. O governo alega que essas iniciativas são necessárias para minimizar os impactos da guerra no Oriente Médio que afeta petróleo e derivados. "O atual governo, muita gente não percebeu ainda, qual é a outra bomba que ele vai jogar no consumidor, quem usa moto, carros e caminhoneiros. O Lula pela Petrobras deu um subsídio de 2 reais no preço do diesel. Ele acaba no dia seguinte à eleição. É isso que esse governo irresponsável está fazendo“, disse Flávio. Em entrevista coletiva em Brasília para anunciar a prorrogação, o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, negou que ela tenha relação com o período eleitoral e disse que os preços internacionais do petróleo seguem pressionados por causa da guerra no Oriente Médio. No início da tarde desta sexta, os preços do petróleo Brent LCOc1 operavam próximos a US$104, muito acima dos níveis ao redor de US$70 observados antes do início da guerra.

item.title: Trump pushes Mexico for more cross-nation tie-ups between energy companies, FT reports
item.description: US President Donald Trump has insisted on more deals and tie-ups between Mexican and US energy companies in a call with Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump has insisted on more deals and tie-ups between Mexican and US energy companies in a call with Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum, the Financial Times reported on Friday. The leaders have also discussed a deal similar to the one signed last year with South Korea, in which Seoul agreed to buy $100 billion of US energy products and invest billions more in the US, the FT said, citing people familiar with the matter. A US official told the FT the leaders discussed the prospect of Mexico increasing purchases of US natural gas, on which it already depends for about three-quarters of its demand. The talks were focused on reducing Mexico’s trade surplus with the US, the official said.

item.title: GRANOS Futuros del maíz caen tras aumento de previsiones de rendimiento para EEUU por parte del USDA
item.description: Los futuros del maíz estadounidense se desplomaban el viernes hasta alcanzar el límite diario de cotización, después de que el Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos sorprendiera a los operadores con un aumento inesperado de sus previsiones de cosecha para 2026.
item.dc:creator: Karl Plume
item.content:encoded: Los futuros del maíz estadounidense se desplomaban el viernes hasta alcanzar el límite diario de cotización, después de que el Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos sorprendiera a los operadores con un aumento inesperado de sus previsiones de cosecha para 2026. La soja y el trigo seguían la tendencia bajista del maíz, presionados por el aumento de las previsiones de existencias del USDA para ambos cultivos. El USDA prevé que la cosecha de maíz de Estados Unidos alcance los 16.034 millones de bushels, frente a los 15.800 millones previstos hace un mes, con un rendimiento promedio de 181,2 bushels por acre, frente a los 178,5 bpa anteriores. Esta revisión ha incrementado las previsiones de existencias al final de la temporada en 282 millones de bushels con respecto al mes anterior. Los analistas encuestados por Reuters esperaban, en promedio, que las estimaciones de producción y rendimiento promedio disminuyeran tras las condiciones meteorológicas adversas para los cultivos de este verano boreal. "Que el USDA haya constatado un aumento de la producción este año ha sido una sorpresa. Y, de hecho, que el incremento haya sido tan grande ha supuesto una auténtica sorpresa. Así que, obviamente, ha sido un reporte negativo y el mercado está reaccionando de forma negativa", afirmó Jack Scoville, analista de The Price Group. Los futuros de referencia del maíz de diciembre de la Bolsa de Comercio de Chicago bajaban 29,50 centavos hasta alcanzar un mínimo de dos meses de 4,7075 dólares por bushel a las 1650 GMT, tras caer hasta el límite diario de 30 centavos luego de la publicación del reporte. Los futuros de marzo también tocaron brevemente el límite a la baja. La soja de noviembre perdía 16,5 centavos hasta 12,71 dólares el bushel, su mínimo en seis semanas, mientras que el trigo de diciembre descendía 19,75 centavos hasta alcanzar un mínimo de dos meses de 6,635 dólares el bushel.

item.title: US FDA approves Asahi Kasei's drug for persistent herpes infections
item.description: The US FDA on Friday approved Japan's Asahi Kasei's drug for persistent herpes simplex virus sores in certain patients with weakened immune systems who have not responded to available antiviral treatments.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US FDA on Friday approved Japan's Asahi Kasei's (3407.T) drug for persistent herpes simplex virus sores in certain patients with weakened immune systems who have not responded to available antiviral treatments. The oral drug, called pritelivir, was developed by German drugmaker Aicuris, which Asahi Kasei acquired in April Pritelivir blocks proteins the herpes virus needs to copy its genetic material, stopping it from multiplying and allowing the drug to work against some infections resistant to older treatments Older first-line drugs must be activated by a viral enzyme before blocking replication, and mutations that disrupt this activation can cause resistance The US Food and Drug Administration's approval was based on a late-stage trial involving 101 participants, in which sores healed completely within 28 days in 62.7% of patients who were given pritelivir, compared to 34% receiving other treatments The trial compared pritelivir with doctors' choice of intravenous foscarnet, the main approved alternative, or cidofovir and imiquimod — older medicines used off-label The commonly reported side effects in the trial included headache, diarrhea, nausea, reduced appetite, vomiting and dizziness Asahi Kasei had previously estimated pritelivir could serve about 15,000 US patients with weakened immune systems, and generate peak annual sales of more than $400 million in the mid-to-late 2030s

item.title: Serbia hit with stadium closure and fines over supporter misconduct
item.description: Serbia will play their next home game behind closed doors and their FA has been fined 50,000 euros ($56,000) after fans engaged in racist and discriminatory behaviour in Nations League matches against Greece and Netherlands, UEFA said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Serbia will play their next home game behind closed doors and their FA has been fined 50,000 euros ($56,000) after fans engaged in racist and discriminatory behaviour in Nations League matches against Greece and Netherlands, UEFA said on Friday. The UEFA Control, Ethics and Disciplinary Body (CEDB) also fined the Serbian FA 22,500 euros for "transmitting messages not fit for a sports event", 2,000 euros for lighting pyrotechnics and 15,000 euros for a pitch invasion during the two matches, both of which Serbia lost 2-1 last month. In a separate case relating to Serbia's 2-1 defeat away to the Netherlands on October 4, UEFA fined the country's FA 20,000 euros and imposed a one-match ban on selling tickets to supporters for an away match, suspended for two years, for racist and discriminatory behaviour. Serbia were fined a further 20,000 euros for transmitting a message not fit for a sports event during that match. Kosovo were fined 15,000 euros for displaying a message not fit for a sports event and another 20,000 euros for racist and discriminatory behaviour by fans during a 3-1 Nations League loss to Austria last month. UEFA also imposed a one-match ban on away ticket sales, suspended for two years. Croatia were fined 20,000 euros and handed a one-match ban on away ticket sales, suspended for two years, following racist and discriminatory behaviour by supporters during a 4-1 thrashing by world champions Spain last month. item.title: Trump to push US officials to use Defense Production Act to raise oil, fuel output, three sources say
item.description: President Donald Trump will soon issue a directive to some of his department heads to find ways to control prices of diesel fuel which are near record highs in the weeks before the November 3 congressional elections that will determine control of Congress, three industry sources said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump will soon issue a directive to some of his department heads to find ways to control prices of diesel fuel which are near record highs in the weeks before the November 3 congressional elections that will determine control of Congress, three industry sources said on Friday. The directive, which could take the form of a presidential memo, will push officials to find ways to bypass local and state regulations blocking energy production and use the Cold War-era Defense Production Act to increase output of oil and fuel, the sources said.

item.title: Le copilote de Flydubai voulait s'inspirer du 11-Septembre - procureur
item.description: Le copilote omanais du vol Flydubai à destination d'Israël dérouté le 30 septembre vers l'Arabie saoudite voulait s'emparer des commandes de l'avion et le précipiter sur l'aéroport de Tel Aviv-Ben Gourion, a déclaré vendredi le procureur général des Emirats arabes unis, cité par l'agence officielle émiratie.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le copilote omanais du vol F[USN:L8N45M0TT TEXT:"lydubai"] à destination d'Israël dérouté le 30 septembre vers l'Arabie saoudite voulait s'emparer des commandes de l'avion et le précipiter sur l'aéroport de Tel Aviv-Ben Gourion, a déclaré vendredi le procureur général des Emirats arabes unis, cité par l'agence officielle émiratie. Dans un communiqué présentant de manière détaillée les résultats de l'enquête ouverte le 1er octobre, Hamad Saïf al Chamsi a déclaré que le projet s'inspirait des attentats du 11 septembre 2001 aux Etats-Unis. Le suspect avait déjà effectué deux vols entre Dubaï et Tel Aviv pour "se familiariser avec le trajet et l'aéroport", selon les investigations. Le copilote a blessé le pilote de l'appareil avec la hache de secours du cockpit avant d'être maîtrisé et empêché de parvenir à ses fins par des passagers. Il avait travaillé précédemment pour plusieurs compagnies aériennes dont Oman Air et Royal Air Maroc, avant de rejoindre Flydubai en janvier 2026.

item.title: Holland & Knight, other firms disclose data security breaches
item.description: Two more large US law firms, Holland & Knight and Squire Patton Boggs, have disclosed data security breaches to state regulators, and a third was hit with a new proposed class action in federal court over a reported hack.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Two more large US law firms, Holland & Knight and Squire Patton Boggs, have disclosed data security breaches to state regulators, and a third was hit with a new proposed class action in federal court over a reported hack. Holland & Knight, which employs 2,200 lawyers, and the 2,600-attorney Squire Patton Boggs both told Vermont’s state attorney general on Thursday that Social Security numbers were exposed in the incidents that affected the firms. Holland & Knight in a statement said "a threat actor used social engineering techniques to gain unauthorized remote access to a firm computer." It said it "identified the small number of files involved and promptly notified the clients whose information was contained in those files." Squire Patton Boggs in a statement said its incident involved "an unauthorized third party obtaining a limited set of information from the firm." Both firms said there was no disruption to their client services. Separately, law firm Nelson Mullins was sued on Wednesday in federal court in South Carolina for allegedly failing to safeguard private information following a breach at the firm. In a statement, the firm said a cyber group that targets law firms “accessed the laptop of a single user and copied a limited number of documents accessible by this user.” The firm, which employs more than 1,000 lawyers, said the incident “was contained and did not involve any other systems, devices, or accounts.” Nelson Mullins said it was in contact with law enforcement authorities and supporting their investigation. The latest disclosures underscore cybersecurity risks for law firms, which routinely hold sensitive client communications, financial records and personal data that can be valuable to hackers. Recent breaches at major law firms have highlighted how cybercriminals are increasingly targeting the legal industry through tactics including so-called social-engineering schemes designed to gain access to confidential information. Several law firms including WilmerHale and Weil Gotshal have paid a ransom or suppression payment following a data breach. WilmerHale is also facing a lawsuit in DC federal court over its alleged breach. item.title: Sainz, enfadado tras un "error humano" que le frenó en la clasificación para el sprint de Singapur
item.description: Carlos Sainz, de Williams, criticó el viernes a la FIA tras un error de la dirección de carrera que ralentizó a los autos que luchaban por clasificarse para la carrera al sprint de Singapur, afirmando que el fallo le recordó a los problemas de software que se produjeron en el Gran Premio de Baréin, celebrado en Malasia.
item.dc:creator: Tom Westbrook
item.content:encoded: Carlos Sainz, de Williams, criticó el viernes a la FIA tras un error de la dirección de carrera que ralentizó a los autos que luchaban por clasificarse para la carrera al sprint de Singapur, afirmando que el fallo le recordó a los problemas de software que se produjeron en el Gran Premio de Baréin, celebrado en Malasia. Después de que la primera sesión de clasificación para la carrera sprint se suspendió con bandera roja cuando el Cadillac de Sergio "Checo" Pérez se estrelló contra una barrera, el personal de control de carrera reactivó tardíamente el "modo de adelantamiento" durante 27 segundos antes de desactivarlo para el resto de la sesión. El "modo de adelantamiento" proporciona a los pilotos potencia adicional y su activación ayudó a los pilotos que estaban marcando un tiempo de vuelta al final de la sesión, mientras que Sainz quedó eliminado. "La mitad de los autos completaron la vuelta con un motor medio segundo más rápido que los demás. Esta vez hubo otro problema de software con los autos y nosotros salimos perjudicados", afirmó el piloto español. "Por la razón que sea, la FIA, al igual que en Malasia, no decidió aplicar la equidad deportiva y no le importó que la mitad de los autos en la clasificación tuvieran más potencia que la otra mitad", señaló. "Así que me confunde un poco que el deporte siga actuando de forma diferente dependiendo de quién quede fuera en la Q1 (primera sesión de clasificación) o quién lo haga en la primera vuelta", agregó. El pasado fin de semana, un fallo de software provocó el caos en Sepang, donde los monoplazas redujeron la velocidad hasta casi detenerse en las dos vueltas de formación que se realizaron después de que los comisarios de carrera anularan la salida original debido a la fuerte lluvia. La FIA afirmó en un comunicado que hubo un "error humano" que dejó desactivado el modo de adelantamiento tras el periodo de bandera roja, antes de que se reactivara durante 27 segundos y se desactivara de nuevo. "La FIA reconoce que este desafortunado error humano afectó al rendimiento de determinados autos en función del momento de su vuelta y de su posición en la misma", señaló, añadiendo que el segundo y tercer periodos no se vieron afectados. Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, logró la pole position en la sesión de clasificación para la carrera al sprint del Gran Premio de Singapur, por delante del Mercedes de George Russell.

item.title: Precios bonos Tesoro EEUU caen por alza del petróleo, inversores se centran en próximos datos de inflación
item.description: Los precios de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos caían el viernes, revirtiendo parte de las ganancias de inicios de semana, mientras el valor del petróleo se mantenía alto y los inversores aguardaban los próximos informes de inflación en busca de pistas sobre las medidas que tomará la Reserva Federal en su reunión de política monetaria del 27 y 28 de octubre.
item.dc:creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
item.content:encoded: Los precios de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos caían el viernes, revirtiendo parte de las ganancias de inicios de semana, mientras el valor del petróleo se mantenía alto y los inversores aguardaban los próximos informes de inflación en busca de pistas sobre las medidas que tomará la Reserva Federal en su reunión de política monetaria del 27 y 28 de octubre. "Estamos viendo cómo los precios del petróleo suben ligeramente a medida que avanza la sesión, y la preocupación mundial sigue siendo la misma: si los precios más altos de la energía van a mantenerse por más tiempo", dijo Chip Hughey, director general de renta fija de Truist Wealth. El crudo Brent subía un 0,7%, a 104,98 dólares por barril, mientras que los futuros estadounidenses ganaban un 0,6%, a 91,94 dólares. El rendimiento de referencia a 10 años avanzaba 2,8 puntos básicos, al 5,261%, tras alcanzar esta semana un máximo en 24 años. El retorno a 30 años se mantenía prácticamente sin cambios, en el 5,602%. Cuando los precios de los bonos del Tesoro caen, los rendimientos suben. "Nos estamos acercando al extremo superior del rango al que llegarán los rendimientos a 10 años a corto plazo, salvo que haya un recrudecimiento de la tensión en Oriente Medio", dijo Hughey, quien agregó que el mercado ha visto cómo los compradores han intervenido cuando el rendimiento a 10 años se ha acercado al rango del 5,30% al 5,35%. En el extremo más corto de la curva, la rentabilidad a dos años , que suele reflejar las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés, subía 5,2 puntos básicos, al 4,808%. La curva de rendimientos se aplanaba por segundo día consecutivo el viernes, y el diferencial entre los rendimientos a dos y 10 años se redujo de 46,7 a 45,3 puntos básicos. Los agentes en el mercado tienen la mirada puesta en los datos de inflación de la próxima semana. Los próximos informes del Índice de Precios al Consumidor y del Índice de Precios al Productor se publicarán el miércoles y el jueves, respectivamente.

item.title: FCC chief defers to Pentagon on airing US execution on TV networks
item.description: The chair of the Federal Communications Commission said on Friday that he would defer to the Pentagon on whether US networks could air a planned December 3 military execution, which would be an unprecedented broadcast.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The chair of the Federal Communications Commission said on Friday that he would defer to the Pentagon on whether US networks could air a planned December 3 military execution, which would be an unprecedented broadcast. US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Thursday that the execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, a former Army psychiatrist convicted of killing 13 people and wounding 32 others at the Fort Hood military base in Texas in 2009, would be livestreamed. Carr told CNBC it was his understanding this would not air on broadcast TV. But asked if he would allow it to be aired, he said: "Ultimately we're going to defer to Secretary Hegseth and you know his decisions on how to move forward with this." An FCC spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment. ABC, NBC, CBS and Fox did not immediately respond to requests for comment on whether they are considering airing the execution. Andrew Jay Schwartzman, a senior counselor at the Benton Institute for Broadband & Society and expert on FCC issues, said there is no legal basis for the commission to intervene in a broadcaster's decision on whether to air a live execution. "There is absolutely no justification in the Communications Act or the Constitution that would allow the FCC to tell broadcasters to carry or not carry an actual event," he said, adding, "there is no basis for the FCC to dictate content or to prohibit content short of obscenity." A 2007 report from the FCC on violence on television said the agency did not have the authority to regulate violent content. The report said "violent speech and depictions of violence have been found by the courts to be protected by the First Amendment."

item.content:encoded: La economía peruana habría crecido en agosto a niveles "muy similares" a los de julio, cuando avanzó un 3,56% interanual, dijo el viernes el gerente de política monetaria del banco central, pese a los efectos adversos del fenómeno climático de El Niño. El crecimiento de julio [USN:L1N4570M5 TEXT:"superó las expectativas"] de los analistas debido al buen desempeño ese mes de casi todos los sectores productivos del tercer mayor productor mundial de cobre. Carlos Montoro, en una conferencia telefónica, afirmó que los afectos de El Niño ha tenido repercusiones en sectores como la pesca, la agricultura y la industria textil, aunque los sectores no primarios están creciendo a un ritmo del 5%. "Lo que se estima es que el dinamismo en el mes de agosto va a ser muy similar al que hemos visto en el mes de julio, que se observa principalmente una contribución en la actividad económica asociada al PIB no primario (...) pero vemos números muy similares", manifestó el funcionario La cifra de evolución del PIB de agosto la difundirá la oficina de estadística (INEI) el miércoles 15 de octubre. El gobierno de la presidenta Keiko Fujimori proyectó recientemente que la economía cerraría el año con una expansión del 3,4%, debido al impulso de la demanda interna y mayor inversión publica y privada. "Nosotros estamos viendo que el impacto climático va a durar hasta el primer semestre del próximo año y para el segundo semestre ya deberíamos comenzar a ver una mejora en estos sectores", dijo Montoro en referencia al agro y la pesca. El miércoles, mientras analistas preveían un alza de la tasa de interés, la autoridad monetaria mantuvo el costo del financiamiento en 4,25%, nivel en que se ha mantenido estable desde septiembre de 2025, tras una serie de recortes previos. Perú registró una inflación del 1,5% el año pasado, una de las más bajas de la región, y el banco central prevé que alcance el 4,2% este año, según una reciente proyección.

item.title: UN calls US plans to livestream execution 'abhorrent'
item.description: The United Nations on Friday called US plans to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the gunman who killed 13 people at the Fort Hood military base in 2009, "abhorrent" and said it could be a violation of prohibitions against torture.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United Nations on Friday called US plans to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the gunman who killed 13 people at the Fort Hood military base in 2009, "abhorrent" and said it could be a violation of prohibitions against torture. "These kinds of public executions we've seen in other countries, whether it's Iran or Afghanistan ... can constitute a form of cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment, or punishment," UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric told a daily UN briefing in New York. "Showing it live is tantamount ... to it being public, and could be a violation of the prohibition against torture," he said. "A government executing someone in public, or in front of live cameras, frankly, is abhorrent." Hasan is set to become the first person to be executed by US military firing squad since 1945. The execution is scheduled for December 3 at the same sprawling Texas base where Hasan opened fire with a handgun in a medical facility.

item.title: Mike Ditka, Hall of Fame player and Bears coach, dies at 86
item.description: Mike Ditka, a Pro Football Hall of Fame tight end best known as the slick-haired and mustachioed head coach who led the NFL's Chicago Bears to their only Super Bowl triumph in 1986, has died. He was 86.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mike Ditka, a Pro Football Hall of Fame tight end best known as the slick-haired and mustachioed head coach who led the NFL's Chicago Bears to their only Super Bowl triumph in 1986, has died. He was 86. Ditka's death was announced in a statement by his family on Friday. No cause of death was given. "It is with profound sadness that we announce the passing of our beloved husband, father, grandfather, and friend," Ditka's family said in a statement. "While the world knew Mike as a Hall of Fame football player, legendary coach, and leader of the Chicago Bears’ Super Bowl XX championship team, we knew him as the heart of our family. "Mike will be missed beyond measure and remembered forever." Revered in Chicago and famous nationwide as "Da Coach," Ditka was a blunt, straight-talking legend with a devoted following and restaurants bearing his name. He also sold a number of products with his name on, including cigars, sausages and wine. TRANSFORMED THE TIGHT END POSITION As a player, Ditka revolutionized the tight end position and was a five-time Pro Bowl selection while playing with the Bears from 1961-66 before moving on to the Philadelphia Eagles and then the Dallas Cowboys, where he featured in the team's Super Bowl triumph in January 1972. Selected fifth overall by the Bears in the 1961 NFL Draft, Ditka introduced a new dimension to the tight end position that once was viewed primarily as an assignment for a tough, talented blocker. While Ditka, also affectionately known as "Iron Mike," was a superior blocker, he became one of the first tight ends to catch a large number of passes. He earned Rookie of the Year honors after becoming the first tight end in NFL history to record 1,000 receiving yards in a season and went on to win the 1963 NFL championship with Chicago prior to the start of the Super Bowl era. At the time of his retirement after the 1972 season, Ditka ranked second among all tight ends in receptions, according to the Pro Football Hall of Fame. He is also the only individual in the NFL's modern era to win a league title with the same team as a player and head coach. "Mike's impact on the Chicago Bears organization, over decades as a player, coach and proud icon and ambassador for our organization is immeasurable," the team said in a statement. "His integral role in bringing world championships to our city and our franchise, both as a player and as our coach, established prominence and excellence at a world-class level, but also created a lifetime of cherished memories in the hearts and minds of Bears fans that will last for generations." DITKA 'EPITOMIZED FOOTBALL' Following his playing career Ditka became a member of Tom Landry's coaching staff in Dallas where he won a Super Bowl. He eventually returned to Chicago as head coach and turned the Bears into one of the league's most dominant champions. The Bears team that Ditka led to Super Bowl glory featured one of the most vaunted defenses in NFL history and a top-ranked offense. With the likes of Walter Payton, William "The Refrigerator" Perry, Jim McMahon and Mike Singletary, the Bears transcended professional sports and became a global pop culture phenomenon after recording “The Super Bowl Shuffle” rap song and accompanying music video that became an unlikely hit. The song was released weeks before the Bears beat the New England Patriots 46-10 in the Super Bowl. At the time, it was the largest margin of victory in any Super Bowl. After the game, the Chicago players carried Ditka, who was wearing a sleeveless Bears sweater over a formal dress shirt and tie, off the field on their shoulders. "Mike Ditka epitomized football over so many years. He brought intensity, authenticity and an unmistakable personality to everything he did," NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell said in a statement. "As a Hall of Fame player, Super Bowl-winning coach with his beloved and iconic Bears, and as a broadcaster, Mike served as an ambassador for the game and inspired generations of fans."

item.title: UAE says Omani flydubai co-pilot planned suicide attack on Tel Aviv flight
item.description: An Omani flydubai co-pilot had intended to seize a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight and crash it into a terminal at Israel's Ben Gurion Airport on September 30 in a suicide attack before he was thwarted by the captain, the UAE attorney general said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Yasmine Ghania, Enas Alashray, Federico Maccioni
item.content:encoded: An Omani flydubai co-pilot had intended to [USN:L1N45M07P TEXT:"seize a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight"] and crash it into a terminal at Israel's Ben Gurion Airport on September 30 in a suicide attack before he was thwarted by the captain, the UAE attorney general said on Friday. Attorney General Hamad Saif al Shamsi's statement did not appear to implicate flydubai in any wrongdoing, and contained the most detailed account yet from prosecutors about what they believe to have happened. Flydubai was not immediately available for comment. The plan was inspired by the September 11, 2001, attacks on the US, UAE public prosecutors think, as a result of their criminal investigation launched on October 1. It found the suspect had used two previous flights to Tel Aviv to "familiarise himself with the flight route and the airport", the state news agency WAM reported. It is the first public confirmation of the co-pilot's 9/11 inspiration. The aircraft was in Saudi airspace when the co-pilot attacked the captain with a crash axe, typically kept in the cockpit for use during emergencies. The incident caused the airliner to [USN:L4N45Q00M TEXT:"plunge"] 16,000 feet (4,900 meters) in 30 seconds before the attacker was overwhelmed and two other pilots who were on board landed the aircraft safely in Saudi Arabia. The suspect was transferred to the UAE, flydubai's home country. SUSPECT MET PROFESSIONAL AND SECURITY REQUIREMENTS Investigators examined flydubai's recruiting procedures and found the suspect had met all professional and security requirements, including holding a pilot's licence and providing a certificate of good conduct. "However, none of the procedures revealed any indications of his extremist views or his intention to carry out a terrorist plot," Al Shamsi added. He said the 29-year-old had worked for airlines in different countries including Oman Air before joining flydubai in January 2026. The investigation found there were signs of the suspect drifting towards "extremism and terrorism" as early as 2017, while he was studying in Australia. Royal Air Maroc has said that he underwent three months of training there in 2025, but that his application to work for the airline afterwards was rejected. UAE officials have not identified the suspect; however, a person with direct knowledge of the matter told Reuters he had been identified as [USN:L1N45P01E TEXT:"Hammam al-Hammami"], an Omani national. Al Shamsi said the suspect had told investigators he had prepared psychologically and physically for the attack by viewing material promoting terrorism and taking boxing lessons. Saudi Arabia has launched a [USN:L1N45S12C TEXT:"separate safety investigation"] into flight FZ1073, sources told Reuters.

item.title: Vance says he won't watch livestream of execution; Trump remains silent
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance said on Friday that he would not watch a livestream of the military execution of the gunman who killed 13 people at Fort Hood military base in 2009, while President Donald Trump has yet to comment on the Pentagon plan.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: US Vice President JD Vance said on Friday that he would not watch a livestream of the military execution of the gunman who killed 13 people at Fort Hood military base in 2009, while President Donald Trump has yet to comment on the Pentagon plan. "I don't know that that's actually going to happen," Vance told reporters while campaigning in Ohio. "If it's ultimately livestreamed, I'm not going to be watching it." Trump said at a White House event on Friday that former Army psychiatrist Nidal Hasan would be executed by firing squad. But he has not commented on the livestream plan announced by Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on Thursday that has drawn [USN:FWN45V0WT TEXT:"criticism at home and abroad"]. Some Republican lawmakers and conservative strategists have criticized the decision. Republican US Senator Thom Tillis of North Carolina called the idea "beyond disgusting" in a social media post. "Public executions are what oppressive dictatorships like Iran and Afghanistan do," said the senator, a frequent Trump critic who is not running for reelection. "It should not be happening in America." Hasan is set to become the first person to be executed by US military firing squad since 1945. The execution is scheduled for December 3 at the same sprawling Texas base where Hasan opened fire with a handgun in a medical facility.

item.title: Trump says Russia to supply diesel to US and global market
item.description: President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel to the US and global marketplace in an effort aimed at cutting prices for the fuel ahead of the November midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel to the US and global marketplace in an effort aimed at cutting prices for the fuel ahead of the November midterm elections. The move comes as prices of diesel, used in agriculture, heating homes and trucking goods, are near record highs ahead of the November 3 congressional elections that will determine control of Congress. Trump said in a post on social media he had a "highly successful" discussion with President Vladimir Putin in which they agreed that Russia will immediately supply the diesel. An envoy for Putin, Kirill Dmitriev, praised cooperation between Russia and the United States on diesel and energy in a post on X on Friday, shortly after the call. Trump said Russia would supply another 500,000 tons in November, and another 1,000,000 tons "immediately thereafter." Even more would come after that, Trump said, "based on the condition of their diesel refineries" which have been damaged by attacks during Russia's war on Ukraine. The unusual move comes as the US has imposed sanctions on Russia's energy companies over its war on Ukraine that began in February, 2022. The Treasury Department issued a general license on Friday allowing importation of Russian diesel until April 7 next year. [USN:L1N45U0FQ TEXT:"Diesel prices"], which can drive inflation, are up 70% since the US-Israeli war with Iran began this year, despite two high-profile recent moves by Trump to boost supplies of the fuel: pressuring allies to release emergency reserves and expanding access to tax-exempt red-dyed diesel, which is normally used for farm equipment. The wars in Iran and Ukraine have triggered an unprecedented global fuel supply crunch, pushing average US diesel prices to $6.28 a gallon on Thursday, according to the AAA motorist organization. "Lower prices for Americans, especially our Great Farmers, Ranchers, and Truckers, is my Greatest Priority," Trump said. DEFENSE PRODUCTION ACT Three industry sources said earlier on Friday that Trump will issue a directive in coming days to some US department heads to find ways to control prices of diesel. The directive, which they said could take the form of a presidential memo, will push officials to find ways to bypass local and state regulations blocking energy production and use the Cold War-era Defense Production Act (DPA) to increase output of oil and fuel. Under the DPA, the president has authorities allowing loans, or loan guarantees to expand domestic manufacturing of critical materials and to require companies to prioritize government contracts for essential goods. The White House has been weighing how to use the DPA to expand refining capacity as the war with Iran exposes a US vulnerability to supply disruptions and price spikes. Refining executives [USN:L1N45214P TEXT:"told administration officials"] last month that federal money would be better directed toward making refineries more efficient or expanding existing plants rather than financing an entirely new refinery, which would be considerably more costly and take years to complete. Trump also said he expected gasoline prices to fall soon to levels around $1.85 to $1.95, well below Friday's average price of about $4.37 a gallon, according to AAA.

item.title: CAF reviewing decision to play Africa Cup of Nations every four years
item.description: Confederation of African Football (CAF) President Patrice Motsepe said the organisation was discussing reverting to hosting the Africa Cup of Nations every two years.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Confederation of African Football (CAF) President Patrice Motsepe said the organisation was discussing reverting to hosting the Africa Cup of Nations every two years. Motsepe made the remarks at a CAF strategy conference in Cape Verde on Friday. CAF's decision to stage the continental championship every four years had proved unpopular in many quarters. "We have discussed things over the last few days and are looking at everything, including having the AFCON come back every two years," Motsepe said. He announced in December that there would be Cup of Nations finals in 2027 and 2028, with the next one after that in 2032 and a four-year gap between tournaments to follow. This was to accommodate a new annual Nations League format that would fill up the calendar, which Motsepe said at the time would be more lucrative. The African continental championship, first staged in 1957, has usually been played every two years.
